gui.guhs.menu.personality.tooltip: Every guh has one of these personalities:
gui.guhs.personality.playful.description: Does happy little laps now and then. A bit faster than other guhs.
gui.guhs.personality.lazy.description: Slower, and would rather just lie around.
gui.guhs.personality.vadsig.description: Sniffs up cheese nibbles off the ground and eats them. Easier to tame.
gui.guhs.personality.shy.description: Wild: keeps away from you, unless you're holding cheese nibbles. Harder to tame.
gui.guhs.personality.brave.description: Hits harder and never runs away.
gui.guhs.personality.chatty.description: Makes guh noises twice as often.
gui.guhs.personality.cuddly.description: Now and then heals their owner half a heart when they're close by.
gui.guhs.personality.curious.description: Walks up to nearby players to get a good look at them.

item.guhs.vahoege_vads_shears.lore: Never breaks. Snip away, nyeg! The sheep thinks it is wahoog.

entity.guhs.quest_guh.request: Guh guh... I'm sooo hungry! Bring me %s fried cheese nibbles (in your hand) and you'll get something super chonky. (You have %s now.)
entity.guhs.quest_guh.thanks: Nom nom nom! Thank you! Here, take my buddy the Bank Guh - they can eat anything and are never full!
gui.guhs.bank.deposit.tooltip: Put everything from your inventory (not your hotbar) into the tummy

item.guhs.verloren_guh_taart.lore: Mother Chonky's cake. Don't eat it!
item.guhs.guh_kristal_verrekijker.lore: Use it: rare guhs within 64 blocks start to glow

gui.guhs.guhdex.info.normal: The good old guh. Everywhere in the Guhmension and in guh caves.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.mint: A fresh mint-green guh. Smells like toothpaste.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.snow: A white guh who loves the cold peaks.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.brontosaurus: A guh with a very long neck. Guh-saurus!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.teckel: A sausage guh with six little legs. Very long, very happy.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.ghost: A see-through guh who only shows up at night. Boo-guh!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.starry: His fur is a night sky full of glowing stars.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.rainbow: Keeps changing color. Nobody knows how.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.ender: Rarity: Rare (only in the Guh End, after beating Overlord Mika)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.ender: Enderguh: black and purple with dragon wings. He lives in the Guh End and only lets himself be tamed once you have beaten Overlord Mika (1 in 8 nibbles, or 1 fried nibble). Saddle him and fly!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.koning: The King Guh on his throne in the legendary Guh Castle. Royal purple, a white mane, a little mustache. His outfit is in the treasure room of his castle: go find it!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.reisguh: Rarity: Common (at every portal and in big places)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.reisguh: The Travel Guh: a guh conductor. Right-click to discover him; after that you can travel between all the Travel Guhs you know. There's one at every Guh Portal, at the Guh Castle and in the big places: Guhwarden, Snuggledale, the Guh Fair, Guhland, the Balloon Festival and the Guh Circuit.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.poortwachter: The Gatekeepers of the Guh Castle. They only let guh friends in...
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.showguh: The Show Guh hosts the Chonk Pageant: dress up a model guh for the theme and let the jury decide. With Show Rosettes you can buy the Showstar outfit.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.raceguh: The Race Guh lends you a racing guh: three laps through the rings, over WAHOOG pads and against your own ghost guh.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.mepguh: The Whack Guh hands you a whacker: whack the Mikas on the 4x4 board, but never the guh!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.djguh: The DJ Guh plays the colors first: dance them back in the right order. One wrong step and the music stops.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.golfguh: The Golf Guh lends you a club for 9 holes of guh mini golf. Every hole has three tee mats: green for easy (close to the hole), pink for medium and red for hard (all the way at the back). On hard she puts out extra pink slime bumpers and her guh windmill spins twice as fast. Hold right-click, let go, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.smulguh: The Munch Guh lends you her big platter: catch the falling food for a whole minute, and stay away from Mika's Grease.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.visguh: The Fishing Guh lends you a rod for the fishing contest. You get to keep the special guhfish!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.mijnguh: The Miner Guh lends you a pickaxe for the cheese veins, which you won't find anywhere else.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.bibliothecaris: The Librarian of the Guh Library knows every guh tale. Read them all on the lecterns!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.zeemeerguh: Rarity: Rare (Guh Sea, Deep Guh Sea)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.zeemeerguh: The Merguh: a guh with a fish tail! Swims super fast. Tame him, saddle him and ride underwater.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.golden: A shiny golden guh. Extremely rare!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.brococolief: The guh of the Guh Village. Wears pink, of course.
gui.guhs.maag.locked: You don't have a guhbelly yet... (Mother Chonky's quest)
gui.guhs.maag.no_build: You're not allowed to build in this belly
gui.guhs.maag.grow: Bigger (%s x %s)? Do the Dentist Guh's chores in the mouth.
gui.guhs.maag.max: Your belly is as big as it can get!
gui.guhs.maag.whitelist_off: (the whitelist only counts in whitelist mode)
quest.guhs.vadsig.start: Guh... guhhh... NYEG! Those chonky Mikas have guhnapped my little Guhbert! Follow this Mika Tracker Compass to their camp and bring him back. Pretty please, wahoog hero!
quest.guhs.vadsig.camp: Nyeg, nyeg... The compass points to the Mika Camp. Defeat the Mika Boss and free my Guhbert! Chonk on!
quest.guhs.vadsig.cake: GUHBERT! Wahoog! But... NYEG, my cake for the welcome party is gone! Follow the cake crumbs to a Guh Picnic. And bring 3 guh balloons, or it's not a proper chonky party!
quest.guhs.vadsig.need: For the party I need the Lost Guh Cake (%s) and %s/%s guh balloons. You'll find balloons in picnic chests, or make them from pink wool and string. Nyeg, what a chonky party it's going to be!
quest.guhs.vadsig.party: WAHOOG CHONK! PAAAARTY! Thank you, thank you! Here, my belly whistle: from now on you have your very own guhbelly. Nyeg nyeg!
quest.guhs.vadsig.unlocked: Guhbelly unlocked! Blow the belly whistle or press G.
quest.guhs.vadsig.done: Guh guh! Guhbert and I are so chonky happy. Have fun in your belly, wahoog friend! Nyeg!
quest.guhs.cake.found: You found the Lost Guh Cake! Bring it to Mother Chonky with 3 guh balloons.
quest.guhs.mika.challenge: NYEG! Want that little guh back? Then beat me at rock-paper-scissors. Three times in a row! Nyeg nyeg nyeg!
quest.guhs.mika.play: NYEG! Again? Off you chonk, then.
quest.guhs.mika.won: NYEG HEHE! I picked %s. Back to zero, you chonky thing!
quest.guhs.guhbert.free: Guh! Guh guh! Wahoog! (Guhbert is free and follows you)
gui.guhs.rps.title: Rock-Paper-Scissors-CHONK
quest.guhs.dentist.no_maag: Open wide, nyeg! Oh, you don't have a belly yet. Ask Mother Chonky.
quest.guhs.dentist.max: Your belly is already %s wide. Any chonkier won't fit inside Mother Chonky, nyeg!
quest.guhs.dentist.job: Your belly is %s wide. For %s, bring me this, wahoog:
quest.guhs.dentist.done: Stretch... stretch... CHONK! Your belly is now %s wide.
quest.guhs.enzyme.not_yours: Blub. Nyeg. I only listen to %s.
gui.guhs.guhdex.title: Guhdex
gui.guhs.guhdex.welcome: Welcome to the Guhmension! Here, have a Guhdex: fill it with every guh you meet. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.highscores.no_record: No server record yet: go grab it, wahoog!
quest.guhs.sled.start: Guh... nyeg, my sled is broken! I need a sled runner (guh caves), a guh jingle bell (guh villages) and a pink ribbon (the tailor).
quest.guhs.sled.thanks: Wheee, CHONK! It works again! Take this sled and my sled builder's book - build your own wahoog track!
quest.guhs.sled.unlocked: You can now craft sled rails (the book stays in the recipe grid).
quest.guhs.sled.done: Ding-a-ling! Nyeg nyeg, have fun on the rails!
item.guhs.guh_slee.lore: Put it on a sled rail. Right-click while riding: the control panel
item.guhs.guh_slee.needs_rail: A sled belongs on a sled rail
item.guhs.sleerail.lore: 4x4 blocks. Click the end of a rail to connect to it
item.guhs.sleerail.slope.lore: Goes up 4; sneak (at the end of a rail) to go down
item.guhs.sleerail.blocked: There's no room for this piece of rail
gui.guhs.sled.title: Guh Sled
item.guhs.guh_compass.how: Always points to the nearest one in this dimension; hold it to see how far
quest.guhs.mika.vads_reveal: Nyeg hehe... as long as you don't know the secret CHONK gesture, you'll NEVER beat me. Oops. Nyeg. I shouldn't have said that...
item.guhs.heiligdom_kompas.lore: Points to Mother Chonky's Chonky Shrine (Guhmension). Sold by the Chonk Tamer.
quest.guhs.next.camp: follow the Mika Tracker Compass to the Mika Camp in the Guhmension (hold it to see the distance)
quest.guhs.next.back_to_vadsig: bring Guhbert back to Mother Chonky at the Chonky Shrine
quest.guhs.next.picnic: follow the cake crumbs to a Guh Picnic and walk over the blanket to find the cake
quest.guhs.next.balloons: bring 3 guh balloons (picnic chests, or craft them from pink wool + string) and the cake to Mother Chonky
quest.guhs.swallowed: Mother Chonky swallowed you! This is your spot in her belly: your very own guhbelly. Blow the belly whistle or press G to go back.
quest.guhs.dentist.story.krampjes: Nyeg... hear that rumbling? Mother Chonky has tummy cramps from all those chonky snacks. If I stretch her belly a bit, you get more room and she gets less ouchie. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.dentist.done.krampjes: Stretch... CHONK! The cramps are gone and your belly is now %s wide. Mother Chonky sighs happily.
quest.guhs.dentist.story.mika: Nyeg! There's a Mika smell in her belly... A Big Mika once snatched her favorite plushie, and now she's too nervous to eat properly. Defeat a Big Mika, then I can stretch some more.
quest.guhs.dentist.done.mika: That Mika smell is gone, wahoog! Mother Chonky dares to munch again: your belly is now %s wide.
quest.guhs.dentist.story.goud: Mother Chonky misses her golden nephew... A Golden Guh coming to visit would make her so happy her belly would grow even more. Bring one along (tamed, nearby).
quest.guhs.dentist.done.goud: GOLD! She's so chonky happy her belly just grows: your belly is now %s wide.
quest.guhs.dentist.story.zacht: Her belly wall has gone a bit stiff, nyeg. Guh slime and cheese honey will make it nice and soft and stretchy again.
quest.guhs.dentist.done.zacht: Soft as a pillow! Your belly is now %s wide. Wahoog chonk!
quest.guhs.dentist.story.bloesem: The last and biggest stretch, nyeg! Mother Chonky wants a blossom garden in her belly. Bring guh blossom saplings and crystals, and show me you know every kind of guh (Guhdex).
quest.guhs.dentist.done.bloesem: WAHOOG CHONK! Mother Chonky now has a whole garden in her belly: your belly is %s wide. It really can't get any bigger!
quest.guhs.vadsig.belly.0: Nyeg... what's tickling in my tummy? Oh, it's you!
quest.guhs.vadsig.belly.1: Hmm, I could go for some cheese nibbles... don't eat what's lying around in there, okay!
quest.guhs.vadsig.belly.2: Guh guh... *rumble rumble*... sorry, that was my tummy.
quest.guhs.vadsig.belly.4: Not too much jumping, nyeg, it tickles!
quest.guhs.vadsig.belly.5: Guhbert says hi! He's waving at my tummy.
quest.guhs.vadsig.belly.6: Sometimes I can feel you building... what are you making in there, something chonky?
Ride a lap on the Guh Fair roller coaster
advancements.guhs.guhmension.kermis_outf: Buy the whole fair outfit from the Fair Guh
item.guhs.sleerail.drop.lore: Up 8 over 4 blocks: a real roller-coaster hill. Sneak (at the end of a rail) to go down
item.guhs.sleerail.spiral.lore: Half a turn, up 4: you come back 3 blocks further on. Sneak for left; look down to descend
item.guhs.sleerail.jump.lore: The sled flies 10 blocks through the air. Click the end: the next piece appears at the landing spot by itself
item.guhs.kermiskompas.lore: Points to the Guh Fair in the Guhmension. Sold by the Chonk Tamer.
entity.guhs.guh_slee.hint: Right-click: the control buttons (start, speed, reverse)
quest.guhs.kermis.hello: NYEG! Welcome to the Guh Fair! Every lap on the roller coaster = one fair ticket. Look at all the stuff I've got for tickets... wahoog!
quest.guhs.kermis.first: WHEEEEE! Your first lap on the Guh Fair roller coaster! A prize bag for you: balloons, cheese honey, crystals and 2 extra fair tickets. Chonk!
gui.guhs.menu.sit.tooltip: Let your guh sit right where he is, or stand up again and follow you
gui.guhs.menu.teleport.tooltip: On: your guh teleports to you when you're too far away
gui.guhs.menu.gravity.tooltip: On: heavy and squished flat, can't jump, falls faster
gui.guhs.menu.wander.tooltip: On: your guh chonks around on his own. Off: he stays put like a good guh
gui.guhs.menu.sounds.tooltip: Guh noises on or off, and how often
gui.guhs.menu.radius.tooltip: How far away an aggressive guh attacks monsters and Mikas
gui.guhs.menu.name.tooltip: Give your guh a name (Enter or Rename); no name tag needed
gui.guhs.menu.wardrobe.tooltip: Pick clothes from everything you've unlocked, plus armor and backpack
gui.guhs.menu.sounds.ambient.tooltip: Does your guh make little noises on his own?
gui.guhs.menu.sounds.frequency.tooltip: How often your guh makes a little noise on his own
gui.guhs.sled.reverse.tooltip: Turn around and ride the other way
gui.guhs.sled.speed.tooltip: How hard the guhs pull. Downhill goes faster by itself, uphill slower
advancements.guhs.guhmension.verstop_gew: Find all the hidden guhs in the Hide-and-Guh House
advancements.guhs.guhmension.verstop_det: Buy the whole detective outfit from Hidey Guh
item.guhs.verstopkompas.lore: Points to the Hide-and-Guh House in the Guhmension. Sold by the Chonk Tamer.
quest.guhs.verstop.hello: NYEG! Up for some hide-and-guh? My buddies are hiding in the house below us. Easy, medium or hard? Wahoog!
quest.guhs.verstop.running: Shhh... someone's already seeking! Want to help?
quest.guhs.verstop.broken: Nyeg... my house is broken, I can't find any hiding spots anymore.
quest.guhs.verstop.go: There are %s guhs hidden (%s). Right-click when you find one. Good luck! The pink exit takes you back.
quest.guhs.verstop.not_playing: This guh is hiding... ask the Hidey Guh on the roof if you can join in!
quest.guhs.verstop.won: WAHOOG! All guhs found in %s! You get %s hide-and-guh ticket(s).
gui.guhs.scorebord.place: You're number %s on the scoreboard! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.verstop.stopped: You stop seeking (%s of %s found). See you next time!
gui.guhs.verstop.question: Want to play Hide-and-Guh? Pick how hard. The harder it is, the smaller the guhs and the more tickets.
gui.guhs.verstop.running: A search is already on (%s): %s of %s found, %s player(s). Come help look! (Searching together doesn't count for records.)
gui.guhs.verstop.level.tooltip: %s guhs, %s block(s) long. Find them all: %s tickets, plus %s if you're quick
gui.guhs.verstop.join.tooltip: You go into the house and help look; everyone gets the tickets at the end
gui.guhs.verstop.shop.tooltip: The detective outfit for your guh, for Hide-and-Guh tickets
quest.guhs.verstop.hint.floor: Hint: there's still a guh on the %s, in the %s of the house.
quest.guhs.verstop.hint.lights: Hint: in one room the lights went out and the windows went dark. No guh hiding there anymore!
quest.guhs.verstop.hint.sniff: Hint: hear that? One of the guhs keeps sniffling...
quest.guhs.verstop.tip.confirm: Psst... want a hint? Then I'll make a guh glow for a moment. But careful: your time won't count for your record anymore (you still get your tickets). Click again if you're sure!
quest.guhs.verstop.tip.given: The Hint Guh makes a guh glow for %s. Look quick!
quest.guhs.verstop.tip.wait: Nyeg, hang on... I'll have another hint in %s seconds.
quest.guhs.verstop.tip.nogame: Hi! I'm the Hint Guh. During hide-and-guh you can ask me for a hint every minute. Ask the Hidey Guh on the roof to play!
quest.guhs.verstop.tip.norecord: You used a hint, so this time doesn't count for your record.
gui.guhs.verstop.no_build: Nyeg! The Hide-and-Guh House is sacred: no breaking or building here.
advancements.guhs.guhmension.koning_pakj: Find the whole king outfit in the Guh Castle's treasury
painting.guhs.guh_stapel.title: The Guh Stack
painting.guhs.guh_stapel.author: The guhs
item.guhs.reisguh_fluitje.lore: Blow it somewhere in the Guhmension: a Travel Guh settles there, your own travel point
quest.guhs.reis.discovered: Toot toot! You discovered Travel Guh '%s'. Right-click me to travel to every Travel Guh you know. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.reis.only_guhmension: Nyeg... Travel Guhs only travel within the Guhmension.
quest.guhs.reis.renamed: This Travel Guh is now called '%s'
gui.guhs.reis.name: Name
gui.guhs.reis.rename.tooltip: Give this Travel Guh a new name (for everyone)
gui.guhs.reis.none: You don't know any other Travel Guhs yet. Go find them (there's one at every guh portal, and in big places like Guhwarden, Snuggledale and the Guh Fair) and right-click them to discover them!
quest.guhs.poort.halt: HALT! Who goes there? Only friends of the guhs may enter the King's castle. Prove you're a true guh friend!
quest.guhs.poort.hint1: Psst... true guh friends are really good at chonking. Being nice and lazy, you know. See that little bench over there?
quest.guhs.poort.hint2: A true guh friend knows the secret guh word. It starts with an N... and sounds like a happy guh: N-y-e-...
quest.guhs.poort.hint3: Go sit nice and chonky on the bench for half a minute. Or say the secret word every guh says when it's happy (in chat)!
quest.guhs.poort.friend: Welcome back, guh friend! The King is expecting you. NYEG!
quest.guhs.poort.welcome_lazy: I've never seen anyone sit so chonkily... You really are a guh friend! Go on in. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.poort.welcome_word: NYEG! That's the secret guh word! You're a true guh friend. Welcome to the King's castle!
quest.guhs.poort.pushed: Whoa there! First prove you're a guh friend (talk to the gatekeepers).
item.guhs.koningskompas.lore: Points to the legendary Guh Castle (Guhmension). It can be very far away!
item.guhs.guhmensie_superkompas.lore: Right-click: choose what you're looking for. It points to the nearest one (in this dimension).
item.guhs.guhmensie_superkompas.choose: Right-click to choose what you're looking for
item.guhs.guhmensie_superkompas.chosen: The Super Compass is now looking for: %s
item.guhs.guh_compass.old: Old compass: replaced by the Guhmension Super Compass
gui.guhs.superkompas.pick: Click a place: your Super Compass shows the way!
quest.guhs.reis.picked_up: You picked up Travel Guh '%s'. Put it down somewhere in the Guhmension: that'll be its new travel point.

structure.guhs.challenging_guh_caves.too: Black-and-red tubes, Mika spawners and Big Mika with two treasure chests
structure.guhs.evil_mika_home.tooltip: The dark house of the Mikas, with Mika's Grease in the chest
structure.guhs.vadsig_heiligdom.tooltip: Mother Chonky's quest starts here (your very own guhbelly)
structure.guhs.guh_picnic.tooltip: Quest: the lost guh cake; also the Hungry Guh (Bank Guh)

structure.guhs.verstopguh_huis.tooltip: Minigame: hide-and-guh with Hidey Guh, tickets and a detective outfit
structure.guhs.guh_kermis.tooltip: Minigame: the roller coaster, fair tickets and the fair outfit
structure.guhs.guh_kasteel.tooltip: Legendary: King Guh, the gatekeepers and a treasury (very far away!)
structure.guhs.hamster_house_extra_extra: The very rare guh theme park with a Ferris wheel and a sled track
structure.guhs.guhramid.tooltip: Rare pink pyramid with a Golden Guh in a secret chamber
structure.guhs.guh_statue.tooltip: A giant guh made of blocks
structure.guhs.grand_cheese_fountain.too: Three bowls of cheese sauce and a pink ball
structure.guhs.guh_village.tooltip: Guh villagers with guh careers: trade away!
structure.guhs.hamster_house.tooltip: Small hamster house with a guh spawner
structure.guhs.hamster_house_medium.tool: Hamster house with a big guh
structure.guhs.hamster_house_large.toolt: A whole hamster play town with a mega guh
quest.guhs.minigame.busy: Nyeg, you're still busy with another game! Finish that one first, then you can join in here. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.minigame.dropped: Your pockets are full: %sx %s is lying on the ground right in front of you!
quest.guhs.shop.busy: Just a moment, guh! I'm still helping another customer. You're next!
gui.guhs.protected.no_fire: No fire or buckets next to a guh building, nyeg!
jukebox_song.guhs.ze_hangen: Guh - They Hang On My Chonk
advancements.guhs.guhmension.beauty_show: Buy the whole Showstar outfit from the Show Guh
item.guhs.showrozet.lore: Won on the catwalk of the Guh Beauty Theater. Spend it at the Show Guh.
structure.guhs.guh_beauty_theater.toolti: Minigame: the Show Guh's Chonk Pageant, show rosettes and the Showstar outfit
quest.guhs.beauty.hello_first: WAHOOG, a new face! Welcome to the Guh Beauty Theater. Here we dress up guhs for the Chonk Pageant: I give a theme, you pick clothes from the loaner wardrobe and the model walks the catwalk. The jury gives points, you get show rosettes. Ready?
quest.guhs.beauty.hello: There you are again, top stylist! Another round of chonky glamour?
quest.guhs.beauty.running: Shhh, a show is on! Grab a seat in the stands and clap along. You're up after!
quest.guhs.beauty.busy_self: You're already in the show! Dress your model (click the model or a loaner wardrobe).
quest.guhs.beauty.broken: Nyeg... I can't find my stage anymore. No stage, no show!
quest.guhs.beauty.no_own_guh: I don't see your own guh anywhere! Bring your tame guh along (close by), or pick one of my models.
quest.guhs.beauty.start: Showtime! %s is ready on stage. Three rounds, three themes. Make it chonky!
quest.guhs.beauty.dress_help: Click a piece of clothing to dress the model. Wardrobe closed? Click the model or a loaner wardrobe. Done? Click 'Hit the Catwalk!'
quest.guhs.beauty.walk: A round of applause for %s! The theme: %s. Look at those little hips wiggle!
quest.guhs.beauty.walk_naked: Uh... %s is walking the catwalk without any clothes! Wasn't the theme %s?!
quest.guhs.beauty.pose: %s strikes a pose for the jury... WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.beauty.extase: The jury is ecstatic! They're standing on their cushions clapping!
quest.guhs.beauty.finale: End of the show! Total: %s of %s points. You won %s show rosettes (%s of them bonus).
quest.guhs.beauty.first: Your very first show! The Show Guh has a present: 4 extra show rosettes, balloons and fried cheese nibbles.
quest.guhs.beauty.best: Your record stays at %s points. Even chonkier next time!
quest.guhs.beauty.stopped: The show has stopped. You keep your %s show rosette(s). See you next time!
quest.guhs.beauty.publiek: Shhh, I'm watching the show! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.beauty.title: Guh Beauty Chonk Pageant
gui.guhs.beauty.explain: %s rounds, each with a theme. Dress the model from the Loaner Wardrobe (head, eyes, neck and body), then it struts down the catwalk. Every judge gives 1-10 points: Miss Chonksley judges the theme, Mr. Glitterguh a complete look, Granny Nibbles goes with her heart. Points become show rosettes. You don't need anything yourself!
gui.guhs.beauty.running: %s is on stage right now (round %s of %s, theme %s). Grab a snug seat in the stands and watch!
gui.guhs.beauty.best.none: You've never entered. Time for your debut!
gui.guhs.beauty.start.tooltip: The Show Guh lends you a model. You don't need anything yourself!
gui.guhs.beauty.start_own.tooltip: Your own tame guh walks the catwalk! After the show it gets its own clothes back, and it may also wear what it has on now in the show.
gui.guhs.beauty.start_own.none.tooltip: Bring your tame guh along (within 24 blocks) to let it strut its own stuff.
gui.guhs.beauty.shop.tooltip: The glitter bow, the Miss Chonky Sash and the Showstar Tiara, for show rosettes
gui.guhs.beauty.ready.tooltip: Done dressing up? Then the model struts down the catwalk now.
gui.guhs.beauty.quit.tooltip: Stop the show (you keep the show rosettes you've won)
gui.guhs.beauty.leenkast.closed: The Loaner Wardrobe only opens during your own show. Ask the Show Guh!
gui.guhs.beauty.no_build: Nyeg! The theater is sacred: no breaking or building here.
quest.guhs.beauty.reason.vadsma.perfect: Look at that: %s for %s! A perfect fit, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.beauty.reason.vadsma.good: %s for %s? Quite neat. Not perfect, but chonky enough.
quest.guhs.beauty.reason.vadsma.off: %s for %s?! Nyeg! That fits like a cheese nibble in a birdcage.
quest.guhs.beauty.reason.glitterguh.miss: No hat?! A bald guh head is not a look, darling!
Nothing on the eyes? Glasses, darling, GLASSES! The eyes are the windows to the chonk!
A bare neck! Where's the bow? Where's the drama?
No outfit? That round little guh tummy is begging for one!
quest.guhs.beauty.reason.knabbel.own: %s is a real sweetie. Your own guh always gets an extra nibble from Granny!
quest.guhs.beauty.reason.knabbel.showste: Ooh, a Showstar piece: %s! Granny's heart melts like cheese in the fryer!
quest.guhs.beauty.reason.knabbel.piece: And look: %s! Grandpa Guh used to have one just like it. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.beauty.model_hands_off: Hands off! Only the show's stylist may dress the model.
gui.guhs.beauty.hint.winter: Bundle up: hats, scarves and sweaters!
gui.guhs.beauty.hint.feest: Party hats, bows and loads of color!
gui.guhs.beauty.hint.werk: Which job? A helmet, a cap, a coat...
gui.guhs.beauty.hint.zomer: Sunshine, a straw hat and sunglasses!
gui.guhs.beauty.hint.gala: So fancy! A bow tie, a monocle, a cape...
gui.guhs.beauty.hint.koningsdag: Orange all the way! And a little crown.
gui.guhs.beauty.hint.hollands_weer: Rain, wind and... even more rain.
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.vadsma.hello: I'm Miss Chonksley. I watch the theme: every piece of clothing has to fit. Strict but chonky!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.vadsma.naked: No clothes? Nyeg. One point, for the walking.
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.vadsma.low: That has very little to do with %s, dear.
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.vadsma.high: Neatly within the theme %s. I'm impressed!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.vadsma.top: PERFECT %s! My monocle just popped out!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.glitterguh.hello: Mr. Glitterguh, charmed. I love complete outfits and clothes that go together.
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.glitterguh.naked: A naked guh on MY catwalk? I'm breaking out in glitter hives!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.glitterguh.low: Everything's missing! Hat, glasses, bow, outfit: finish it!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.glitterguh.mid: Cute, but it could be more complete. Head, eyes, neck AND body!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.glitterguh.high: What a complete picture, darling! Almost glitterproof.
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.glitterguh.top: COMPLETE! MATCHING! This is a LOOK! I'm done for!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.knabbel.hello: I'm Granny Nibbles. I give points with my heart. Your own guh or a Showstar piece? Extra cute!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.knabbel.naked: Oh dearie, he must be cold. Still, a nibble for being brave.
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.knabbel.low: I still think he's sweet. Here, a little cheese nibble.
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.knabbel.mid: What a lovely chonky thing. Granny is pleased!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.knabbel.high: Oh, my old guh heart! What a sweetie!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.knabbel.top: WAHOOG! Granny is crying with joy! Ten nibbles!
advancements.guhs.grote_guhspelen.race_l: Finish the old Guh Racetrack on hard
advancements.guhs.guhmension.race_jockey: Buy the whole jockey outfit from the Race Guh
entity.guhs.race_ghost.name: Your record ghost (%s)
structure.guhs.guh_racebaan.tooltip: Minigame: race on a rental racing guh, beat your own ghost and win the jockey outfit
quest.guhs.race.hello_new: VROOM VROOM, NYEG! Welcome to the Guh Racetrack! I'll lend you a racing guh: 3 laps through all the glowing rings, over the bridge and right through the big guh head. The WAHOOG pads give you a boost! You don't need to bring anything, chonk.
quest.guhs.race.hello: Back again? My racing guhs are warmed up and have finished their cheese nibbles. Beat your ghost! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.race.hello_busy: Shhh, there's a race on right now! Watch from the stands and shout real loud: WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.race.busy: %s is racing now (lap %s of %s). Wait a bit, or cheer from the stands!
quest.guhs.race.broken: Nyeg... my racetrack is broken, I can't find the rings anymore.
quest.guhs.race.go: Here's your racing guh! Hold on tight... on your marks...
quest.guhs.race.go_go: Why are you standing here chatting with me? RACE! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.race.controls: W = run (your guh keeps picking up speed), mouse = steer, S = brake, shift = dismount (then you have 5 seconds to hop back on). Through all the rings, in order, and stay on the track!
quest.guhs.race.ghost_on: Your record ghost is racing along again. Ooooooh...
quest.guhs.race.ghost_off: No ghost this time: just you and the racetrack.
quest.guhs.race.shop: The jockey outfit! Only here, only for race prizes. Then your guh will be the fastest-looking guh in the Guhmension.
quest.guhs.race.off: You got off your racing guh! Hop back on within %s seconds (right-click your racing guh), or the race is over.
quest.guhs.race.missed: Nyeg! You skipped a ring. Go back through %s first!
quest.guhs.race.reset: Oopsie! Back to the last ring...
quest.guhs.race.off_track: Nyeg! No cutting corners over the grass, chonk!
quest.guhs.race.result: Over the line in %s (laps: %s). %s! You get %s race prize(s).
quest.guhs.race.first_record: Your first race time: %s. From now on your ghost races along!
quest.guhs.race.record: NEW PERSONAL RECORD: %s (was %s)! From now on your ghost rides this race. +2 race prizes
quest.guhs.race.first: Your very first guh race! A welcome bag: 4 extra race prizes and a handful of cheese nibbles. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.race.track_record: TRACK RECORD! %s raced the Guh Racetrack in %s: first place on the scoreboard! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.race.ended.gave_up: You got off: race over. The racing guh trots back to the pit stop.
quest.guhs.race.ended.too_late: Six minutes and still not home? The racing guh is tired, nyeg. Race over!
gui.guhs.race.question: 3 laps through all the rings: the faster you go, the more race prizes (gold, silver, bronze). Easy, medium or hard? Your best race rides along as a ghost!
gui.guhs.race.busy: %s is racing (lap %s). Wait a bit, or watch from the stands!
gui.guhs.race.start.tooltip: You get a rental racing guh for the race; afterwards it goes back to the pit stop
gui.guhs.race.ghost.tooltip: Your best race rides along with you, see-through (you need a record first)
gui.guhs.race.shop.tooltip: The jockey outfit for your guh, for race prizes
gui.guhs.race.track_record.none: No track record yet: go grab it!
gui.guhs.race.prizes: Gold 6, silver 4, bronze 3, finished 2 race prizes (+2 for a record; hard +50 %)
gui.guhs.race.start.tooltip.makkelijk: A calm racing guh, and if you fall off the track it only goes back a little bit
gui.guhs.race.start.tooltip.medium: The normal race, same as always
gui.guhs.race.start.tooltip.lastig: A super fast but stubborn racing guh, Mika Snatchers along the track, and the silver pads don't work. +50 % race prizes!
gui.guhs.race.goud.tooltip: The world's track record rides along as a golden ghost (if someone else holds it)
quest.guhs.race.niveau.makkelijk: Easy: a calm racing guh, and if you fall off the track I'll put you back just a little bit.
quest.guhs.race.niveau.lastig: Hard! A super fast but stubborn racing guh, Mika Snatchers along the track, and the SILVER WAHOOG pads don't work. Good luck, chonk!
quest.guhs.race.reset_makkelijk: Oopsie! Back just a little bit...
quest.guhs.race.goud_on: The golden ghost is racing along again. Can you beat the track record?
gui.guhs.race.no_build: Nyeg! No digging holes in the racetrack: the racing guhs will trip.
advancements.guhs.guhmension.mika_meppen: Play a round of Whack-a-Mika and earn whack coins
advancements.guhs.guhmension.mika_mep_pa: Buy the whole Mika Hunter outfit from the Whack Guh
item.guhs.mika_mep_hamer.lore: Borrowed from the Whack Guh: it goes back after the game. Left-click the Mikas!
structure.guhs.mika_mep_hal.tooltip: Minigame: Whack-a-Mika with the Whack Guh, whack coins and the Mika Hunter outfit
quest.guhs.mika_mep.hello_first: NYEG! A new whacker! The Mikas keep popping out of my board... Grab my Mika whacking hammer and whack them back into their holes! Up for a game? WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.hello: There you are again! The Mikas are getting cheeky. Another game of whacking?
quest.guhs.mika_mep.running: Shhh, %s is whacking! %s seconds left. Go sit nice and chonky in the stands, you're up after!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.running_you: Why are you talking to me? WHACK! The Mikas are escaping!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.broken: Nyeg... my board is broken, I can't find the holes anymore.
quest.guhs.mika_mep.go: Here's your Mika whacking hammer! Stand on the board and left-click the Mikas. Golden Mika = jackpot. And whatever you do: DON'T WHACK THE GUH!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.help1: Whack-a-Mika: 60 seconds, and the Mikas pop up faster and faster. Left-click them with the whacking hammer!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.help2: A Mika is 10 points, a golden Mika 50. Every 5 in a row your combo goes up (up to x5)!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.help3: Sometimes a guh pops up. DON'T whack it: minus 25 and your combo is gone. Leave it alone and you get 5 points. A Mika that escapes or a whack into an empty hole: combo gone.
quest.guhs.mika_mep.help4: Your score earns you whack coins, and with those you buy the Mika Hunter outfit for your guh. The three best whackers in the world float by the scoreboard wall. You never need your own stuff: while whacking you don't get tired or hurt. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.end: TIME! Your score: %s points (%s Mikas, %s golden, %s guhs whacked by accident, best combo %s).
quest.guhs.mika_mep.coins: You get %s whack coin(s)! The whacking hammer goes back to the Whack Guh.
quest.guhs.mika_mep.first: Your very first game! As a thank-you: %s extra whack coins and a bag of cheese nibbles. Chonk!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.best: Your record stays at %s points. Keep whacking, chonk!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.stop.left: You walked away from the whacking board... the game is over (no whack coins). I'll take the whacking hammer back!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.stop.stopped: Stopped. I'll take the whacking hammer back. See you soon!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.stop.gone: The game of Whack-a-Mika has stopped: the whacking hammer is back with the Whack Guh.
gui.guhs.mika_mep.go.sub: Whack the Mikas, not the guh!
gui.guhs.mika_mep.combo_up: COMBO! +%s  (%s in a row: now x%s!)
gui.guhs.mika_mep.escaped: A Mika got away: combo gone!
gui.guhs.mika_mep.take_hammer: Hold your Mika Whacking Hammer in your hand!
gui.guhs.mika_mep.not_playing: You whack with the Whack Guh's hammer: talk to the Whack Guh to play!
gui.guhs.mika_mep.live.title: WHACK-A-MIKA
gui.guhs.mika_mep.rules:
Mika = 10
Golden Mika = 50
5 in a row = combo up
GUH = -25 (don't!)
gui.guhs.mika_mep.no_build: Nyeg! No breaking or building in the Whack-a-Mika Hall. Only whack the Mikas!
gui.guhs.mika_mep.question: The Mikas keep popping out of my board! Whack them back in: 60 seconds, faster and faster. Whack Coins for your score!
gui.guhs.mika_mep.question.busy: %s is whacking right now (%s s left). Watch from the stands, then it's your turn!
gui.guhs.mika_mep.question.you: You're playing! %s seconds left. Do you really want to stop?
gui.guhs.mika_mep.play.tooltip: You get a borrowed whacking hammer and stand in the middle of the board. You don't need anything yourself.
gui.guhs.mika_mep.help.tooltip: The Whack Guh explains everything (in the chat)
gui.guhs.mika_mep.shop.tooltip: The Mika Hunter outfit for your guh (only sold here!), for Whack Coins
advancements.guhs.guhmension.disco_outfi: Buy the whole disco outfit from the DJ Guh
advancements.guhs.grote_guhspelen.disco_: Dance to the 70s version of "They Hang On My Chonk" at the Guh Disco
Dance the Chonky Tango: slow, dramatic and very, very chonky
Dance to the Mika Mambo, the DJ Guh's fastest song (hard!)
Dance to the bonus song, the Nyeg-Nyeg Boogie
Dance 10 colors in a row right on the Mika Mambo. The Mikas aren't giggling anymore, they're clapping!
Get at least 3 colors right on all four songs
Buy the little disco headphones from the DJ Guh
subtitles.guhs.disco.ze_hangen_disco70: Disco music: They Hang On My Chonk
gui.guhs.disco.lied.ze_hangen_disco70.to: The DJ Guh's signature record: "They Hang On My Chonk" in a groovy 70s disco jacket. Medium: after a while the colors come on double beats.
gui.guhs.disco.lied.vadsige_tango.toolti: Slow and dramatic, with a bandoneon and singing guhs. Easy: a calm tempo and lots of time per step.
gui.guhs.disco.lied.mika_mambo.tooltip: Fast and cheeky: the Mikas sing the chorus! Hard: you start with 3 colors, double beats come soon, and 50% more Disco Coins.
gui.guhs.disco.lied.njeg_njeg_boogie.too: The bonus song with its own top 3: boogie-woogie piano and guhs singing "nyeg-nyeg!". You start with 2 colors.
quest.guhs.disco.title.dubbel.sub: two colors per beat now, nyeg!
block.guhs.disco_milkshake.slurp: Slurp! ...nyeg, this one's just for looking at. Real shakes are sold by the DJ Guh!
structure.guhs.guh_disco.tooltip: Minigame: dance 'Simon says' to the beat of four songs with the DJ Guh, disco coins and a disco outfit
gui.guhs.disco.no_build: Nyeg! Hands off the Guh Disco: no breaking or building here. Just dance!
quest.guhs.disco.hello: YO, WAHOOG! Welcome to the Guh Disco! Pick a song: I play the colors right on the beat and you dance them back. Ready to make your chonk swing?
quest.guhs.disco.busy: Nyeg, the floor is taken! Watch closely and learn from the pros... you're up soon.
quest.guhs.disco.dancing: Hey, you're dancing! Back to the floor, the beat won't wait!
quest.guhs.disco.broken: Nyeg... my dance floor is broken, I can't find my four tile colors.
quest.guhs.disco.go: Song: %1$s (%2$s). Listen to the beat: on every beat a color flashes and a tone plays. Then step on the same colors in the same order! Every round adds one color. The tempo is just the song's... but soon the colors come on double beats. One wrong step and the music stops. The golden cross is safe: you can always stand on that.
quest.guhs.disco.first: Your first dance at the Guh Disco! A welcome present: 4 disco coins and a cheese nibble shake. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.disco.left: You stepped off the dance floor: the music stops!
quest.guhs.disco.done: The music stops! You danced %s colors in a row and get %s disco coin(s).
quest.guhs.disco.record_first: Your first record on %2$s: %1$s colors! Will you make the top 3 above the podium? WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.disco.no_best: No record yet: not a single color right. Next time: listen to the tones, guh!
quest.guhs.disco.title.ready.sub: %1$s - %2$s beats per minute - listen to the beat
gui.guhs.disco.question: The DJ Guh spins a real song and plays a row of colors on the beat: the tiles flash, and every color has its own note. Dance it back, tile by tile! The song is your level.
gui.guhs.disco.running: %1$s is dancing to %3$s right now (round %2$s). Only one at a time: watch and wait for your turn!
gui.guhs.disco.mine: You're dancing (round %s)! Want to stop? You get the Disco Coins for what you've danced so far.
gui.guhs.disco.start.tooltip: You go to the middle of the dance floor, the song starts and after 3, 2, 1 the DJ plays the colors. You don't need anything, and while dancing you don't get hungry or hurt
gui.guhs.disco.stop.tooltip: The music stops; you get Disco Coins for the colors you've danced
gui.guhs.disco.shop.tooltip: The disco outfit and the disco headphones (only here!), shakes and dance floor, for Disco Coins
gui.guhs.disco.munten: Disco Coins in your pocket: %s (1 per 2 colors +1, from 3; Mika Mambo +50%%)
gui.guhs.disco.first: Your first dance comes with a little welcome gift!
advancements.guhs.guhmension.find_guh_go: Find the rare Guh Mini Golf
advancements.guhs.guhmension.golf_gespee: Earn a golf ball at the Guh Mini Golf
advancements.guhs.guhmension.golf_outfit: Buy the whole golf outfit from the Golf Guh
item.guhs.guhgolfclub.lore: Hold right-click near your ball to charge the power bar, look where it needs to go and let go to swing. WAHOOG!
item.guhs.guhgolfclub.loan: Borrowed from the Golf Guh: she wants it back after your round.
structure.guhs.guh_golfbaan.tooltip: Minigame: 9 holes of mini golf with the Golf Guh, golf balls and a golf outfit
quest.guhs.golf.hello1: NYEG! Welcome to Guh Mini Golf! Nine holes, one ball, zero cheese nibbles (I ate them). Up for a round? Wahoog!
quest.guhs.golf.hello2: Fore! Oops, you only shout that when a ball comes flying... I mean: hi! Want to golf? I'll lend you my very prettiest club.
quest.guhs.golf.hello3: Did you know a guh golf ball is really a guh rolled up in a ball? It loves it! Want to play a round?
quest.guhs.golf.playing: You're golfing! Your ball is waiting for you. Want to stop? You can do that here too.
quest.guhs.golf.busy: Nyeg, %s is golfing right now. Watch along or come back in a bit!
quest.guhs.golf.elsewhere: You're already golfing on another course!
quest.guhs.golf.broken: Nyeg... I can't find my holes anymore. Is my course broken?
quest.guhs.golf.full: Your pockets are full! Free up one slot for the golf club, then I'll lend it to you.
quest.guhs.golf.start: Yippee! Here's your golf club. Your ball is ready on hole 1. Ready? 3... 2... 1...
quest.guhs.golf.how: Hold right-click with the club to charge the power bar (the longer, the harder, up to 100%%), look where the ball needs to go and let go to hit. Cheese sauce or out of bounds = 1 penalty stroke. Every hole has three tee mats: green (easy, close to the hole), pink (medium) and red (hard, all the way at the back).
quest.guhs.golf.stopped: You stop golfing. The club goes back in my bag. See you next time!
quest.guhs.golf.walked_away: You walked away from the course. The Golf Guh takes her club back.
quest.guhs.golf.idle: Nyeg, did you fall asleep? The Golf Guh ends your round.
quest.guhs.golf.first_record: Your first round: %s strokes. That's your record right away!
quest.guhs.golf.no_record: Your record stays at %s strokes. Another round?
quest.guhs.golf.first: Your very first round of guh golf! A present from the Golf Guh: 6 golf balls, cheese nibbles and fried cheese nibbles. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.golf.club_record: CLUB RECORD! Your name now floats right at the top above the Golf Guh. Chonkily good!
gui.guhs.golf.bar: Hole %s/9: %s (par %s) | stroke %s/%s | %s blocks to go | total %s
gui.guhs.golf.poke: Nyeg, no poking! Hold right-click with your club and let go to swing.
gui.guhs.golf.wait_ball: Wait until your ball stops rolling!
gui.guhs.golf.too_far: Walk to your ball (within 3 blocks) to swing
gui.guhs.golf.penalty: +1 penalty stroke, your ball goes back
gui.guhs.golf.no_build: Nyeg! The Guh Mini Golf is sacred: no breaking or building here.
gui.guhs.golf.question: A round of Guh Golf? 9 holes, at most 8 strokes per hole. The fewer strokes, the more golf balls!
gui.guhs.golf.mine: You're golfing (hole %s). You can stop any time.
gui.guhs.golf.busy: %s is golfing (hole %s). Watch or wait a little!
gui.guhs.golf.play.tooltip: You get a golf club and your ball is ready on hole 1
gui.guhs.golf.stop.tooltip: Your round stops; you keep the golf balls you already have
gui.guhs.golf.shop.tooltip: The golf outfit for your guh, for golf balls
gui.guhs.golf.club: Club record (no. 1 of the top 3): %s with %s strokes
advancements.guhs.guhmension.find_vadsig: Find the Chonky Food Fest, the big guh feast
Buy the bib, the baker's hat and the pink apron from the Munch Guh
item.guhs.smulschaal.lore: Borrowed from the Munch Guh: it goes back after the game
structure.guhs.vadsig_eetfestijn.tooltip: Minigame: catch falling food with the Munch Guh, munch coins and the munch outfit
gui.guhs.smul.no_build: Nyeg! At the food fest we munch, we don't break or build.
quest.guhs.smul.hello: NYEG! Welcome to the Chonky Food Fest! Hungry? In my arena it rains food. Catch as much as you can in one minute!

quest.guhs.kaasmijn.hello: NYEG! Welcome to the Cheese Mine! Deep below us, cheese grows in the rocks. Here, my loaner pickaxe: hack at the yellow veins and the chunks are yours. When you leave the mine, I'll take it back. WAHOOG, happy hacking!
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.loan: Here, a loaner pickaxe. Only for inside the mine, okay? Nyeg!
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.on_floor: Nyeg, your loaner pickaxe is just lying there on the ground! Pick it up, one per guh, chonk.

quest.guhs.kaasmijn.tip0: Take the stairs down, or do the WAHOOG Jump: there's water at the bottom, honest!
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.tip1: Tired pawsies? The Cheese Express rides laps through the cheese tunnels. Press the minecart dispenser!
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.tip2: Gold cheese only grows really deep, in the deepslate. The cheese vault in the treasure room loves it...
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.tip3: A mined-out vein grows back all by itself. Cheese is patient, just like a chonky guh.
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.tip4: Want to look like a real miner guh? I've got a helmet with a lamp, overalls and a hanky for cheese chunks. Not sold anywhere else, WAHOOG!

book.guhs.bieb.eerste_guh.title: The Very First Guh
book.guhs.bieb.eerste_guh.0: Long, long ago there was nothing at all. Just a soft pink nothing, as soft as a pillow. And right in the middle of that nothing lay one crumb. A cheese nibble crumb.
book.guhs.bieb.eerste_guh.1: The crumb lay there for a very long time. It got warm, it got round and it got... chonky. One day it opened two big blue eyes and said the very first word ever: 'Guh.'
book.guhs.bieb.eerste_guh.2: And that's how the first guh was born. His name was Firstguh. Firstguh was all alone, so he did what every guh does when he feels lonely: he ate a cheese nibble. And another. And another.
book.guhs.bieb.eerste_guh.3: From every cheese nibble Firstguh shared with the pink nothing, a new guh grew. That's why guhs still say: share your snacks, gain your pals. Guh!
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.eerste_guh.0: Where did the very first guh come from?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.eerste_guh.1: What was the very first guh called?
book.guhs.bieb.moeder_vadsig.title: How Mother Chonky Got So Chonky
book.guhs.bieb.moeder_vadsig.0: Mother Chonky used to be a perfectly ordinary guh. A little round, sure. But not THAT round. Not shrine-round. How did that happen?
book.guhs.bieb.moeder_vadsig.1: It began on a rainy Tuesday. Mother Chonky baked a guh cake for every little guh in the Guhmension. That's a LOT of guhs. And of course she had to taste every cake first.
book.guhs.bieb.moeder_vadsig.2: One bite per cake. But there were a thousand cakes. After cake five hundred she no longer fit through the door. After cake one thousand she no longer fit in the village. CHONK!
book.guhs.bieb.moeder_vadsig.3: So the guhs built a shrine around her, so she wouldn't have to walk anymore. She's been sitting there ever since, sweet and enormous, looking after all the little guhs. Especially Guhbert.
book.guhs.bieb.moeder_vadsig.4: Her tummy is so big that a whole guhbelly fits inside, with a Dentist Guh and an Enzyme Guh. Help her out and you get a belly whistle. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.moeder_vadsig.0: Why did Mother Chonky get so chonky?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.moeder_vadsig.0.0: She tasted a thousand guh cakes
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.moeder_vadsig.0.2: She slept for a hundred years
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.moeder_vadsig.1: What do you get for helping Mother Chonky?
book.guhs.bieb.kaasknabbels.title: The Secret of the Cheese Nibble
book.guhs.bieb.kaasknabbels.0: Why are cheese nibbles so yummy? Learned guhs have researched it for a hundred years. And while doing so, they ate a whole lot of cheese nibbles. For science, of course.
book.guhs.bieb.kaasknabbels.1: Their conclusion: a cheese nibble is a little bit of cheese, a little bit of nibble and a whole lot of love. Give a guh a nibble, and you give it a little piece of love.
book.guhs.bieb.kaasknabbels.2: That's why you become friends with a guh when you feed it nibbles. And that's why a fried cheese nibble (with Mika's Grease!) heals a guh all the way in one go. Extra love. Extra grease.
book.guhs.bieb.kaasknabbels.3: Nine cheese nibbles together make a block. And a frame of cheese nibble blocks makes a gate to the Guhmension. Nobody knows why. It sure smells lovely in there, though.
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.kaasknabbels.0: According to the learned guhs, what's in a cheese nibble?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.kaasknabbels.0.0: Cheese, nibble and a whole lot of love
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.kaasknabbels.1: How many cheese nibbles go into one block?
book.guhs.bieb.guhmensie.title: Travel Guide to the Guhmension
book.guhs.bieb.guhmensie.0: Welcome to the Guhmension, the pink land of the guhs! Grab your compass and your nibbles: we're going on a trip. Tip: bring a Guhmension Super Compass, then you'll never get lost.
book.guhs.bieb.guhmensie.1: The Guh Fields and the Guh Meadows: soft, pink and full of guhs. The Cheese Flats: yellow and a little bit stinky. The Pink Puffs: so soft you'll want to sleep in them.
book.guhs.bieb.guhmensie.2: The Guh Peaks: cold and high. The Enderguhs used to fly there, but they have moved to the Guh End. The Chonk Cliffs: steep, so mind your tummy. The Guh Sea: blue and full of little guhfish. Underground: sparkly guh crystals.
book.guhs.bieb.guhmensie.3: And then there's Mika's Biome. Dark, scary and full of Mikas. Only go there with a good sword and an empty belly. Or a full one. Mikas don't care either way. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.guhmensie.0: Where did the Enderguhs use to fly?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.guhmensie.1: Which biome is dark and scary?
book.guhs.bieb.mika_oorlog.title: The Great Mika War
book.guhs.bieb.mika_oorlog.0: Not everyone in the Guhmension is sweet. There are also Mikas: dark, grumpy creatures who say NYEG in a very cross way. They steal nibbles and snatch little guhs.
book.guhs.bieb.mika_oorlog.1: Long ago, the Mikas challenged the guhs to a war. But guhs don't like fighting. They're far too chonky for that. So they suggested: rock-paper-scissors!
book.guhs.bieb.mika_oorlog.2: The Mikas kept winning. Because the Mika Boss cheated: he knew the secret CHONK gesture, which beats everything. Until one clever guh copied the gesture and threw it right back.
book.guhs.bieb.mika_oorlog.3: 'I'VE BEEN CHONKED!' cried the Mika Boss, and the war was over. Since then the Mikas live in their own camp. Sometimes they still grab a little guh. Then you know what to do. CHONK!
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.mika_oorlog.0: How was the Great Mika War decided?
book.guhs.bieb.koningskroon.title: The Crown of the King Guh
book.guhs.bieb.koningskroon.0: In a castle far, far away lives the King Guh. Purple fur, a white mane, a very distinguished little mustache. He sits on a golden throne and rules over all the guhs. Sort of.
book.guhs.bieb.koningskroon.1: His crown is called the Wahoog Guh King Crown. It's made of the very first gold of the Guhmension, found by the Golden Guh himself, and polished by a thousand little guh teeth.
book.guhs.bieb.koningskroon.2: Whoever wears the crown must promise three things: cuddle all guhs, never take the last nibble and have a nap every afternoon. The King usually manages two.
book.guhs.bieb.koningskroon.3: The gatekeepers only let true guh friends in. How do you prove it? By sitting very chonkily, or by saying the secret guh word. It starts with an N...
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.koningskroon.0: What must you promise when you wear the crown?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.koningskroon.1: What letter does the secret guh word start with?
book.guhs.bieb.vahoeg.title: WAHOOG! The Guh Dictionary
book.guhs.bieb.vahoeg.0:
GUH: hello, bye, yes, yummy, and pretty much everything.

NYEG: I'm happy! (Or very cross, if a Mika says it.) So pay close attention to who's saying it.
book.guhs.bieb.vahoeg.1:
CHONK: nice and lazy and round. A guh who chonks lies on the couch with a nibble.

CHONKY: plump, round, cuddly. The nicest compliment you can give a guh.
book.guhs.bieb.vahoeg.2: WAHOOG: the happiest word of all. You shout it when you do something awesome: a fair ride, finding a Golden Guh, or eating a whole bag of nibbles in one go.
book.guhs.bieb.vahoeg.3: WAHOOG CHONK: the strongest metal in the Guhmension. Very happy and very chonky at the same time. Tools made of it never break. Just like a guh's love. Aww.
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.vahoeg.1: What do you shout when you do something awesome?
book.guhs.bieb.roze_maan.title: Why the Moon Is Pink
book.guhs.bieb.roze_maan.0: If you look up at night in the Guhmension, you'll see a pink moon and pink stars. But once upon a time the moon there was just white. Boring white. So how did that happen?
book.guhs.bieb.roze_maan.1: A little guh named Guhmmie couldn't sleep. The moon was far too bright. So she climbed the highest Guh Peak and blew an enormous pink bubblegum bubble. It got stuck to the moon.
book.guhs.bieb.roze_maan.2: Ever since, the moon has been pink and shines softly, like a night-light. The stars? Those are the crumbs of the nibbles Guhmmie ate afterwards. She never came back down...
book.guhs.bieb.roze_maan.3: ...just kidding. She slept wonderfully afterwards. Try watching the sky in the Guhmension for a whole night. Maybe you'll see a tiny pink dot waving at you.
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.roze_maan.0: Why is the moon in the Guhmension pink?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.roze_maan.0.0: A bubblegum bubble is stuck to it
book.guhs.bieb.gouden_guh.title: The Golden Guh and the Guhramid
book.guhs.bieb.gouden_guh.0: Of all the guhs, there's one that shines like the sun: the Golden Guh. If you see him, you get to make a wish. Most guhs wish for nibbles. Very predictable.
book.guhs.bieb.gouden_guh.1: The Golden Guh loves hiding. Deep inside the pink Guhramid he has a secret chamber, where he lies chonking among the treasures. Sometimes he lets a treasure hunter in.
book.guhs.bieb.gouden_guh.2: Sometimes he plays Hide-and-Guh with Hidey Guh, but then he always wins: you can't see him anywhere, and yet he's shining. Nobody understands how he does it.
book.guhs.bieb.gouden_guh.3: Ever find him? Then very carefully bring him to the Dentist Guh, who knows exactly what to do with that much shiny chonkiness. Open wide!
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.gouden_guh.0: Where does the Golden Guh hide?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.gouden_guh.1: Who do you bring the Golden Guh to?
book.guhs.bieb.guhmaag.title: A Journey Through the Guhbelly
book.guhs.bieb.guhmaag.0: Did you know you can live inside a guh? Well, inside a guhbelly. Mother Chonky gives you a belly whistle, and toot: you're standing in a soft pink room with a tongue for a rug.
book.guhs.bieb.guhmaag.1: In every belly lives an Enzyme Guh. It only listens to the boss of the belly. Blub. It keeps everything tidy and digests whatever doesn't belong. Unwanted guests too.
book.guhs.bieb.guhmaag.2: Want a bigger belly? Go to the Dentist Guh. For cheese nibbles, Wahoog Chonk Ingots and crystals, the Dentist Guh stretches your belly. Stretch, stretch... CHONK! Until it really can't go any further.
book.guhs.bieb.guhmaag.3: A belly is the snuggest home there is. There's always food nearby. And remember: the chonkier, the better. For the belly, that is. Your own tummy just stays your own tummy.
book.guhs.bieb.slee_kermis.title: From Sled Hut to Fairground
book.guhs.bieb.slee_kermis.0: Guhs are much too chonky to walk. That's why they invented the sled. It all started with the Sled Guh, high up on the Guh Peaks, in a little hut that smells of hot chocolate.
book.guhs.bieb.slee_kermis.1: His sled was broken, until a kind stranger found a sled runner, a little guh bell and a pink ribbon. Then the Sled Guh taught everyone how to build rails. Ding-a-ling!
book.guhs.bieb.slee_kermis.2: Soon the guhs built a whole fair, with a roller coaster full of chonk drops and guh corkscrews. Every ride: a Fair Ticket. The Fair Guh sells top hats for them. Fancy!
book.guhs.bieb.slee_kermis.3: And whoever finds Hidey Guh's house can play Hide-and-Guh: little guhs hiding in big rooms. The guhs' motto: play first, then chonk, then play some more. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.slee_kermis.0: What did the Sled Guh need for his sled?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.slee_kermis.0.0: A runner, a little bell and a ribbon
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.slee_kermis.1: What do you get for a ride on the roller coaster?
book.guhs.bieb.geheim.title: The Secret Guh Book
book.guhs.bieb.geheim.0: If you're reading this, you've found the secret bookcase. Well done, clever little sleuth! This is the most secret book in the whole library. Don't tell anyone. Except guhs.
book.guhs.bieb.geheim.1: The big secret: Mikas used to be guhs too. They kept all their cheese nibbles to themselves and never shared. Their fur turned dark, their eyes turned red, and their 'guh' turned into 'NYEG'.
book.guhs.bieb.geheim.2: But deep down inside, every Mika is still a little bit guh. That's why the oldest guhs say: if a Mika ever shares a nibble, maybe it'll turn pink again. It has never happened. Not yet.
book.guhs.bieb.geheim.3: The second secret: the Guhmension only exists because someone once gave a guh a cheese nibble. Every nibble you share makes the pink land a little bit bigger. Truly.
book.guhs.bieb.geheim.4: So: share your nibbles, cuddle your guhs and take a nap now and then. Then everything will be fine. Signed, the Librarian. (Psst: secretly I read a comic now and then too.) WAHOOG!
book.guhs.bieb.guheinde.title: The Guh End
book.guhs.bieb.guheinde.0: Long ago, all the guhs shared their cheese nibbles. Then came Overlord Mika. He was the biggest, the meanest and the hungriest Mika of them all.
book.guhs.bieb.guheinde.1: Overlord Mika came up with a plan: if he had all the nibbles, the guhs would turn gray and skinny and the Mikas would be in charge. He called it 'the Great Nibble Heist'. Nyeg.
book.guhs.bieb.guheinde.2: He dug cheese cellars under the Guhmension to hide nibbles in, and stole the last big Enderguh. It never got a single nibble. Poor thing.
book.guhs.bieb.guheinde.3: On his Enderguh he flew to a faraway island: the Guh End. There he locked the nibbles inside crystals on tall cheese pillars, so nobody could reach them.
book.guhs.bieb.guheinde.4: But the guhs say a hero with twelve Eyes of Chonky will find the way. Smash the crystals, feed the Enderguh... and the nibbles come home. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.guheinde.0: What did Overlord Mika put in the crystals?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.guheinde.1: What should you give the worn-out Enderguh?
book.guhs.bieb.voorraadkelder.title: The Diary of the Pantry Mika
book.guhs.bieb.voorraadkelder.0: Diary of Mika Nibblesworth, Head Keeper of the Silent Pantry. Down here under the holey cheese we keep ALL the cheese nibbles of the Guhmension. Nyeg, the guhs will never find them!
book.guhs.bieb.voorraadkelder.1: Pantry Rule 1: NO NIBBLING. Nibbling makes noise. The nibble sensors hear everything: footsteps, chopping and especially chewing. So always sneak, like a real Mika.
book.guhs.bieb.voorraadkelder.2: Our guard is the Chonk Warden. He once ate so many stolen nibbles that he fell asleep, deep in the cheese. Now he's blind from all that sleeping, but his ears... they can hear a crumb drop a mile away.
book.guhs.bieb.voorraadkelder.3: Three shrieks from the nibble shriekers, and he wakes up. That's our secret, nyeg! Any guh reading this had better run away fast. Or be very, very quiet. Guhs are never quiet. Hee hee hee.
book.guhs.bieb.voorraadkelder.4: PS: I secretly ate a nibble. Ever so quietly. The Chonk Warden heard me anyway... Whoever finds this: bring the nibbles back to the guhs, so they can finally be WAHOOG again. Nyeg... sorry.
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.voorraadkelder.0: What does the Chonk Warden hear best?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.voorraadkelder.1: How many times do the nibble shriekers shriek before the Chonk Warden wakes up?

gui.guhs.evenement.start.parade: Boom boom! The CHONK PARADE is marching by! Walk along with the Drummer Guh all the way to the very end for a surprise. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.evenement.start.sterrenregen: Look up: a STAR SHOWER! Where a star lands, a star guh sometimes appears. Tame him quick, before he goes back to the stars!
gui.guhs.evenement.kaasregen.golden: A GOLDEN cheese nibble! No wild guh can resist that...

emote.guhs.verlegen.description: Hides their eyes behind their pawsies... and peeks.
emote.guhs.gapen.description: A huge yawn and a long stretch. Good morning, guh!
emote.guhs.zingen.description: Sings a guh song and wiggles along. Gardens nearby grow faster from it!
emote.guhs.knuffelen.description: Gives a big chonky cuddle. Hearts!
emote.guhs.hartjes.description: Blows little hearts your way, paw to snoot. Sweet chonkies together!
emote.guhs.knuffeldansje.description: A happy twirly dance with little hops. Mega sweet and mega chonky!
emote.guhs.bff_knuffel.description: Stands up on their hind pawsies and hugs you as hard as they can. Soulguh bff 5evr <3
emote.guhs.verdrietje.description: Ears down, a tiny sigh... oh nyeg. Luckily a cuddle always helps.

structure.guhs.onderwater.tooltip: In the middle of every Deep Guh Sea: a glass bubble on the seabed, with the Merguh's shop, giant clams and a shipwreck
quest.guhs.onderwater.hello: Blub blub, WAHOOG! Welcome to the Guh Bubble, the only dry spot at the bottom of the Guh Sea! The giant clams here sometimes have a pearl inside: down here, pearls are money. Need air outside? Swim to the cheese coral, it blows bubbles. And just north of my bubble there's a sunken guh ship... nyeg, I never dared to peek inside.
quest.guhs.onderwater.tip0: A closed clam opens again all by itself. Pearls grow slowly, just like a chonky guh!
quest.guhs.onderwater.tip1: With a diving helmet you can stay underwater as long as you like. Only ten pearls, blub!
quest.guhs.onderwater.tip2: Cheese coral blows air bubbles. Swim close and breathe in: WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.onderwater.tip3: Out in the Guh Sea my wild cousins swim around, the Merguhs. Cheese nibbles, a saddle and hup, underwater riding!
quest.guhs.onderwater.tip4: Goggles, a snorkel and a swim ring: the diving outfit for your guh. Only I sell it, nyeg!
quest.guhs.onderwater.shell_closed: This clam is closed... a new pearl is growing. Come back later!
quest.guhs.onderwater.shell_pearl: The clam opens: a pearl! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.onderwater.no_build: Nyeg! The Guh Bubble is made of glass and mother-of-pearl: hands off, or it'll fill up with water!
quest.guhs.onderwater.ride: Blub! On a Merguh: look where you want to go, jump = up, sneak = get off.
quest.guhs.onderwater.air: Blub... fresh air from the cheese coral!

gui.guhs.superkompas.einde.tooltip: On the way to the Guh End. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guheinde.oog_alleen_guhmensie: Nyeg... the Eye of Chonky only blinks in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.guheinde.oog_niks: The eye looks around, confused. There's no Nibble Cellar to be found here
gui.guhs.guheinde.oog_kapot: NYEG! The Eye of Chonky broke. There's Mika Tear in it, that explains a lot
gui.guhs.guheinde.portaal_open: Twelve Eyes of Chonky stare at you... The portal to the Guh End opens. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guheinde.subtitel: Where all the nibbles went. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guheinde.aankomst: Hear that? NYEG NYEG NYEG! Overlord Mika is coming on his poor, starving Enderguh!
gui.guhs.guheinde.kristal_kapot: A Nibble Crystal broke: the nibbles rain back down! %s more to go.
gui.guhs.guheinde.uitgeput: All the Nibble Crystals are broken! The Enderguh is worn out and lands on Nibble Mountain... Give him a cheese nibble!
gui.guhs.guheinde.gevoerd: WAHOOG!!! The Enderguh finally has a nibble. He throws Overlord Mika off!
gui.guhs.guheinde.schat_open: Click-clack... Overlord Mika's nibble hoard under Nibble Mountain is open!
gui.guhs.guheinde.oproep: The Nibble Crystals are glowing... Overlord Mika can smell nibbles. He's coming back!
gui.guhs.guheinde.bewaard: The Mikas only snatched your cheese nibbles. You still have everything else. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guheinde.beloning.eerste: For you: the Nibble Crown, the Overlord Mika Trophy and your very own Wahoog Enderguh! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guheinde.beloning.ei: Overlord Mika leaves an Enderguh Egg behind. Place it and wait for it to hatch!
gui.guhs.guheinde.mika_huilt: The Mika Boss cries two big fat Mika Tears. Nyeg...
gui.guhs.guheinde.larfje.roof: A Mika Grub snatches a cheese nibble! Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guheinde.mager.honger: The skinny guh looks at you hungrily. Do you have a cheese nibble?
gui.guhs.guheinde.mager.vahoeg: G... guh? GUH! WAHOOG!!! Thank you, sweet hero! I'm running home!
gui.guhs.guheinde.enderguh.niet_meppen: Don't whack the guh! It's not his fault. Whack Overlord Mika!
gui.guhs.guheinde.enderguh.bang: The Enderguh is too scared of Overlord Mika. Smash the Nibble Crystals first!
gui.guhs.guheinde.enderguh.blij: The Enderguh happily flaps his wings. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guheinde.ei.0: The Enderguh Egg wobbles a little
gui.guhs.guheinde.ei.1: There's a little crack in the Enderguh Egg! You hear a soft 'guh'
gui.guhs.guheinde.ei.2: The Enderguh Egg is cracking! Just a little longer...
gui.guhs.guheinde.opper.vloer: NYEH-HEH! As long as I'm riding my Enderguh, you'll never chonk me down!
gui.guhs.guheinde.opper.hulpjes: MIKAS! Over here! Grab those nibbles!
gui.guhs.guheinde.opper.lui: Fly, you lazy chonky beast! NYEG!
gui.guhs.guheinde.opper.eraf: NYEEEEG! My Enderguh! Who gave him a nibble?!
gui.guhs.guheinde.opper.roof: Overlord Mika snatches %s cheese nibbles from you! Nyeh-heh!
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.verhaal1: Guh... Welcome, hero. I must tell you something. The cheese nibbles in my kingdom are running out. Everywhere. My guhs are turning gray and skinny.
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.verhaal2: It's Overlord Mika, the boss of all Mikas. He snatches them and takes them to the Guh End, an island far, far away. Without nibbles, no guh is wahoog!
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.verhaal3: Make an Eye of Chonky: a guh crystal, a cheese nibble and a Mika Tear. Mikas cry sometimes, especially Big Mika and the Mika Boss. Throw the eye in the Guhmension: it flies toward a Nibble Cellar.
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.verhaal4: In the cellar there's a portal. Fill it with twelve eyes and bring the nibbles back. Here, read this book. Chonk on, hero!
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.hint_traan: No Eye of Chonky yet? Make Mikas cry: Big Mika in the Challenging Guh Caves cries the hardest. Or beat the Mika Boss three times with CHONK.
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.hint_oog: Throw your Eye of Chonky in the Guhmension and follow it. Where it dives down, dig for the Nibble Cellar!
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.ridder1: You did it! Overlord Mika is chonked and the nibbles are coming back. Kneel, hero...
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.ridder2: *tap tap with a cheese nibble* I dub thee Knight of the Guh End! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.dank: Knight! Thanks to you, my guhs are wahoog again. Will you come by for a nibble sometime?
structure.guhs.stille_voorraadkelder.too: Deep in the Holey Cheese Caves: the Mikas' secret pantry. SHHH, no nibbling!

quest.guhs.gatenkaas.warning.2: NYEEEG! There's chewing, closer and closer... Sneak, guh! (2/3)
quest.guhs.gatenkaas.warning.3: NYEEEEEEG! The Chonk Warden is coming! (3/3)
quest.guhs.gatenkaas.vadswaker_wakker: The Chonk Warden crawls out of the cheese! It's blind, but it hears your steps and especially your chewing. Run away or sneak, WAHOOG!

gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kaasmot: A teeny-tiny Mika moth with holey-cheese wings. Flutters around cheese and lamps and snatches cheese nibbles off the ground. Nyeg! Frogguhs think they're delicious.

gui.guhs.guhdex.info.moerasheks_mika: A Mika in a pointy hat. Throws Chonk-Be-Gone Potions (making you Unwahoog for a bit) and nibbles her own swamp cheese when she's hurt. Drops swamp cheese!
quest.guhs.kaasmoeras.onvahoeg: Bleh... you suddenly feel a lot less wahoog.

quest.guhs.kaasmoeras.heks1: Swamp Witch Mika: Hee hee hee! A Chonk-Be-Gone Potion, just for you!
quest.guhs.kaasmoeras.heks2: Swamp Witch Mika: You're way too wahoog for my swamp. Let's fix that, nyeg!
quest.guhs.kaasmoeras.heks3: Swamp Witch Mika: My cheese moths have snatched all your nibbles, hee hee!

Grow four Chonkwood saplings in a square into a giant guh tree
block.guhs.guhnestje.lore: Guhs sleep in it at night, the whole family. Your tame guhs too!
item.guhs.guhnestje.lore: Guhs sleep in it at night, the whole family. Your tame guhs too!
item.guhs.knabbelbessen.lore: Baby guhs adore them: wild baby guhs are easy to tame with them
block.guhs.vadshout_zaailing.lore: Four in a square: a giant guh tree!
item.guhs.vadshout_zaailing.lore: Four in a square: a giant guh tree!
structure.guhs.boomhutdorp.tooltip: Guh treehouses high up in the giant guh trees of the Chonkwood Forest, with the Ranger Guh and the Nibble Picker
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.boswachterguh: Looks after the Chonkwood Forest and all the guh families. Sells chonkwood, saplings, guh nests and the ranger outfit.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.knabbelplukker: Picks nibbleberries all day long and trades them for all sorts of things. Careful: sometimes she eats the harvest herself.
quest.guhs.vadswoud.boswachter.hello: Nyeg, a visitor in the Chonkwood Forest! I'm the Ranger Guh. I look after the giant guh trees and all the guh families. Just look at the baby guhs: they walk in a little line behind their parent. WAHOOG, so cute!
quest.guhs.vadswoud.boswachter.tip0: At night the guh families snuggle up together in a guh nest. Put one by your house and your tame guhs will sleep in it too. Chonk!
quest.guhs.vadswoud.boswachter.tip1: A wild baby guh is much easier to tame than a big one. With nibbleberries it almost always works, nyeg!
quest.guhs.vadswoud.boswachter.tip2: Plant four chonkwood saplings in a square and a giant guh tree grows. Listen closely: those trees giggle sometimes.
quest.guhs.vadswoud.boswachter.tip3: Those guh faces in the bark? That's the trees themselves. Give them a tap and their mood changes. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.vadswoud.boswachter.tip4: The Mikas want to snatch our nibbleberries, because then the guhs won't get wahoog enough. Nyeg! That's why I'd rather pick them myself.
quest.guhs.vadswoud.boswachter.tip5: My ranger hat and ranger coat? I've got them in guh size too. Your guh will look so chonky!
quest.guhs.vadswoud.plukker.hello: Hi hi! I'm the Nibble Picker. I pick nibbleberries from the bushes. Want to trade? For nibbleberries I've got tarts, nests and my picking outfit. Nyeg, no sneaky snacking, okay... *munch*
quest.guhs.vadswoud.plukker.tip0: Nibbleberries don't prickle, you know. You just walk right through them. Pick them when they're yellow, then they grow back.
quest.guhs.vadswoud.plukker.tip1: Baby guhs love nothing more than nibbleberries. Give a wild baby guh one and it'll often want to come with you right away!
quest.guhs.vadswoud.plukker.tip2: Three nibbleberries, sugar and a cheese nibble: a nibbleberry tart. WAHOOG, now that's chonky!
quest.guhs.vadswoud.plukker.tip3: I still had a hundred this morning, but... *hic*... I only ate a few. Honest. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.vadswoud.plukker.tip4: Give your tame baby guh nibbleberries and it'll grow up faster. From chonk to wahoog!
gui.guhs.vadswoud.baby_getemd: WAHOOG! The baby guh wants to come with you!
gui.guhs.vadswoud.baby_bessen: Nom, nibbleberries! The baby guh grows a little bit.
gui.guhs.vadswoud.alleen_babys: Nyeg, nibbleberries are for baby guhs. Big guhs want cheese nibbles!
gui.guhs.vadswoud.slaapt: %s is sleeping snugly in the guh nest. Zzz...
gui.guhs.vadswoud.reuzenboom: WAHOOG! A giant guh tree grew from your saplings!
item.guhs.aanmaakblokje.lore: Click inside a grill coal frame (Guhmension or Barbecuether): the barbecue fires up! Also works as a lighter.
item.guhs.grillguh_recept.lore: With charcoal, flint and a cheese nibble it makes Fire Starter Cubes. The recipe stays in the grid.
structure.guhs.barbecueput.tooltip: Broken barbecues with a grill coal frame. The Grill Guh lives in the big one (and in the Barbecuether itself)
gui.guhs.superkompas.barbecue.tooltip: Everything for barbecuing, from the Guhmension all the way into the Barbecuether
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.grillguh: A guh chef with a sky-high chef's hat and an apron. The Mikas swiped his Fire Starter Cubes! Help him and he'll teach you his secret grill recipe.
quest.guhs.barbecuether.wrong_dimension: Nyeg... this barbecue portal only wants to burn in the Guhmension or the Barbecuether!
quest.guhs.grillguh.hallo1: NYEG, my barbecue! The Mikas pinched my Fire Starter Cubes! And my lovely grill coal frame is broken too, chonk...
quest.guhs.grillguh.hallo2: Will you help me? First the frame: it needs grill coal. Here's how you make grill coal: let cheese sauce flow over a block of coal. Sssss... grill coal! Put the missing pieces back (break out the cracked stones), then we'll talk some more.
quest.guhs.grillguh.frame_hint: The grill coal frame isn't whole yet, nyeg. Tip: cheese sauce over a block of coal = grill coal. The cracked stones in the frame have to come out too!
quest.guhs.grillguh.frame_ok: WAHOOG, the frame is whole again! Now just my Fire Starter Cubes... Those chonky Mikas are in a Mika Camp. Defeat a few: as long as you're helping me, every Mika there drops a Fire Starter Cube.
quest.guhs.grillguh.blokjes_hint: My Fire Starter Cubes are with the Mikas in a Mika Camp (the Super Compass can find one). Defeat a Mika there and bring one back!
quest.guhs.grillguh.blokjes_terug: My Fire Starter Cubes! Nyeg nyeg, they smell like Mika. Now click the grill coal frame with one: light my pit!
quest.guhs.grillguh.aansteken: Click the grill coal frame with a Fire Starter Cube and my barbecue will burn again!
quest.guhs.grillguh.klaar1: WAHOOG, my barbecue is burning again! Smell that? Cheese frying sauce, all the way from the Guhbarbecuether!
quest.guhs.grillguh.klaar2: Here: my secret grill recipe (so you can make Fire Starter Cubes yourself) and a bag of fried cheese nibbles, so your guh gets nice and WAHOOG. My chef's hat? I sell that in my little shop!
quest.guhs.grillguh.recept_weer: Nyeg, did you lose my recipe? Here, I had a spare copy. Don't show it to the Mikas!
quest.guhs.grillguh.mika_drop: The Mika drops a stolen Fire Starter Cube!
quest.guhs.grillguh.tip0: Through the portal it's hot, really hot. Cheese frying sauce burns, so no jumping in, chonk!
quest.guhs.grillguh.tip1: In the Satay Grove giant satay skewers grow, and in the Sausage Woods there are bratwursts as big as trees. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.grillguh.tip2: A bed in the Barbecuether? Nyeg! Way too hot to sleep.
quest.guhs.grillguh.tip3: One step there is eight steps here. Handy for quick travel, if you can stand the heat!
quest.guhs.grillguh.tip4: Cheese sauce on cheese frying sauce turns into grill coal. That's how you can always build a new frame in the Barbecuether.
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.root.desc: Grill coal, Fire Starter Cubes and a very hot dimension
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.grillkool: Make grill coal: cheese sauce over a block of coal
Light the Grill Guh's barbecue again and get his secret recipe
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.binnen.de: Step through a barbecue portal into the Guhbarbecuether
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.alle_biom: Visit all five biomes of the Barbecuether
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.emmer.des: Scoop up a bucket of cheese frying sauce
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.gloeikool: Grab a block of glowcoal from the Barbecuether's ceiling
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.te_warm.d: Try to go to bed in the Barbecuether. Nyeg!
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.pakje.des: Buy the whole chef outfit from the Grill Guh
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.terug.des: Go back to the Guhmension through a barbecue portal
item.guhs.guhdrankje.vahoegheid.lore: Cheese broth with nibbles. You run like a guh chasing a nibble: WAHOOG!
item.guhs.guhdrankje.rookloop.lore: Cheese broth with glowcoal. Through smoke, fire and cheese frying sauce without a single scorch mark.
item.guhs.guhdrankje.sluipknabbel.lore: Cheese broth with swamp cheese or Mika's Grease. Quiet as a nibble in a bag, nyeg.
item.guhs.guhdrankje.guhsprong.lore: Cheese broth with guh slime. Boing! And gently back down.
structure.guhs.spiesburcht.tooltip: A keep of charcoal stone with long bridges, Spark Mikas and a little peanut sauce garden (Barbecuether)
structure.guhs.mika_grillpaleis.tooltip: The palace of the Nether Mikas: a mountain of stolen cheese nibbles and chonk treasure chests (Barbecuether)
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.asguh: Rarity: Uncommon (only in the Ash Vale)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.asguh: A gray, sooty guh with glowing cheeks from the Ash Vale of the Barbecuether. Fire doesn't bother him. Feed him a cheese nibble and he glows with joy!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.rookguh: A sad, skinny little guh ghost made of smoke, lost in the Barbecuether. Feed him cheese nibbles (from your hand or thrown): with every nibble he gets rounder and pinker, and then he floats home all WAHOOG. Hit him? Nyeg, never!
quest.guhs.rookguh.honger: The Smoke Guh gives you a pitiful look... It wants cheese nibbles! (%s more)
quest.guhs.rookguh.gevoerd: Nom! The Smoke Guh is getting a bit rounder. %s more nibbles until WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.rookguh.vahoeg: WAHOOG! I'm chonky enough again to float home!
quest.guhs.rookguh.niet_slaan: Nyeg! You don't hit a Smoke Guh, you feed it.
quest.guhs.rookguh.gered: You've already rescued %s Smoke Guh(s)! (see the Smoke Guh in your Guhdex)
quest.guhs.aangebrande_mika.wakker: WHO... BURNT ME?! My nibbles! Nyeg, you'll pay for that!
quest.guhs.aangebrande_mika.doorgebakken: NYEG! Now I'm getting really crispy! Spark Mikas, help!
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.vol_vuur: The barbecue is already blazing, nyeg!
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.gestookt: Sssss... the barbecue under the cauldron is lit!
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.saus_erin: Blub! A pot full of cheese broth. Now stir in an ingredient.
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.nog_even: Let it bubble a little longer...
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.leeg: The pot is empty. First a bucket of cheese sauce!
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.eerst_ingredien: Just cheese broth? Stir in an ingredient first, chonk!
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.eerst_saus: First put a bucket of cheese sauce in the pot!
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.al_brouwsel: There's already a brew bubbling in the pot.
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.koud: The barbecue is cold! Fire it up with grill skewer powder.
quest.guhs.knabbelbaken.geen_piramide: Put the Nibble Beacon on a pyramid of Blocks of Wahoog Chonk!
quest.guhs.nether_mika.boos: GRRR, nyeg! You hit us. No trading!
quest.guhs.nether_mika.bezig: Nyeg, wait a sec! I'm still sniffing.
quest.guhs.nether_mika.ruil: The Nether Mika tosses you something. Nyeg, fair is fair!
quest.guhs.asguh.blij: The Ash Guh is glowing all over with joy!
