advancements.guhs.verhalen.root.title: Guh Tales
advancements.guhs.verhalen.root.descript: Step into the Guhmension: Baltoguh, Guhtwo, 626-guh, the Snuggleheart and the Carpenter Guh are waiting for you there. Nyeg!
advancements.guhs.diertjes.root.title: Critters of the Guhmension
advancements.guhs.diertjes.root.descript: Put one of the Guhmension's sweet critters in your Guhdex: a finch, a duckling, a hedgehog... or Shuckly?
advancements.guhs.verhalen.verhaal_toend: Find the Snowguh Tundra, the white hill country where Nomguh lies hidden somewhere
advancements.guhs.verhalen.verhaal_guhwa: Find an islet of Guhwai'i in the Deep Guh Sea: palm trees, coconuts and warm sand
advancements.guhs.verhalen.verhaal_kompa: Pick a place in the new Tales tab of your Super Compass
gui.guhs.verhaal.kopie.guh: Nyeg? I'm busy with my story. Come back in a bit!
gui.guhs.verhaal.kopie.baltoguh: Sniff sniff... do you smell that too? Snow. Lots and lots of snow. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kopie.mewtwo: I'm... twice as hungry. Which is pretty wahoog, actually.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kopie.stitch626: Blub-nyeg! (626-guh looks at you with big eyes and quickly hides something behind his back.)
gui.guhs.wolkjes.dood: %s has gone up to the clouds... nyeg. A glowing little star stayed behind, and all his memories.
gui.guhs.wolkjes.tab: ☁ %s is up in the clouds... nyeg. His diary stays here, full of sweet memories.
gui.guhs.wolkjes.wist: I'm up in the clouds for a while, all soft and all pink. Do you still think of %1$s? I think of you. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.terug_uit_de_wol: I was up in the clouds for a bit, but the Snuggleheart beat and then I was back. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.huisje.van_wie: This is %1$s's house (%2$s). Only %1$s can change it.
gui.guhs.superkompas.verhalen.tooltip: The places of the great guh tales: Nomguh, Clone Island, the Cloud Chapel, Guhwai'i and the Carpenter Guh's building site
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.timmerguh: Rarity: One in every Snuggledale town (at the building site, at the end of the street past Coco's house)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.timmerguh: The Carpenter Guh builds a Guh House at the edge of every Snuggledale town: a house shaped like a guh head, with ears for a roof. His little helmet is always a bit crooked and he hums with every tap of his little hammer. Will you help with the ear roof? Then he'll teach you to build houses yourself, in all three sizes. Building together is twice as chonky, nyeg!
advancements.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh_bou: Find the building site at the edge of a Snuggledale town and meet the Carpenter Guh
advancements.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh_dak: Together with the Carpenter Guh, put the ear roof on his half-built guh house
advancements.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh_bew: Let one of your guhs live in the house you got from the Carpenter Guh
advancements.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh_kla: Get the Carpenter Guh's building booklet: now you can build all three Guh Houses yourself!
advancements.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh_knu: Put a toy and a little guh lamp by one of your Guh Houses (an extra chore from the Carpenter Guh)
item.guhs.timmerguh_bouwboekje.lore: All three Guh Houses are in it: small, medium and large.
item.guhs.timmerguh_bouwboekje.lore2: Just stays in your crafting table when you build a house. Tap tap, nyeg!
item.guhs.timmerguh_dakpluisje.lore: Borrowed from Carpenter Guh. Only fits on the see-through spots of his ear roof.
Hi! I'm Tappy, the Carpenter Guh's little helper. I hold the nails. Well... most of the time. Nyeg.
Cheese first, then hammering! That's what the Carpenter Guh always says. That's why I'm sitting nice and chonky at the lunch table.
My little helmet is just as crooked as the Carpenter Guh's. One day I'll be a real carpenter guh too. Tap tap, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.timmerguh.past_niet: That roof fluff only fits on the see-through spots of Carpenter Guh's ear roof.
gui.guhs.timmerguh.nog: Pluff! %s more spots and the ear roof is done!
gui.guhs.timmerguh.vertel_het: %s lives in your house now! Hurry and tell Carpenter Guh, nyeg!
gui.guhs.timmerguh.alleen_kijken: Only the owner can change this house. But you're welcome to have a good look, nyeg!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.hallo: Hi hi! I'm the Carpenter Guh. Tap tap, nyeg! See that half-built house? It's a guh house, shaped like a guh head. The walls are up, but the ear roof... I can't finish that on my own.
quest.guhs.timmerguh.uitleg: A guh house is a home for your tame guhs (and mousies and little turtles). They sleep in it, play nearby and do chores there. If you help me with this roof, I'll teach you how to build them yourself. In all three sizes!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.vraag: Yippee! For the roof I need %s planks (any wood) and %s pink wool: I'll make roof fluffs out of it. Will you bring them? Then we'll put the ear roof on together.
quest.guhs.timmerguh.nodig: Got the stuff yet? Planks: %s of %s. Pink wool: %s of %s. Any mix is fine, as long as they're planks. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.materiaal_heb: Ooh, I see %s planks and %s pink wool! Can I have them? Then I'll turn them into roof fluffs right away.
quest.guhs.timmerguh.dak_uitleg: Tap tap tap... done! Here are %s roof fluffs. Climb up the scaffolding (the ladder by the site hut) and right-click each see-through spot on the roof with a roof fluff. Don't forget the ears!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.nieuw_dak: The last house is done... and a little guh family moved right in, nyeg! So we'll just put another roof on. Here are %s roof fluffs: climb up the scaffolding and right-click each see-through spot.
quest.guhs.timmerguh.dak_nog: %s more spots, then the ear roof is on! Climb up the scaffolding and right-click the see-through spots with your roof fluffs. I'll hold the ladder, promise.
quest.guhs.timmerguh.dak_laatste: Only %s spots left? Those are so tricky to reach, I'll tap them in myself! Tap tap, poof!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.dak_af: TOPPING OUT! The ear roof is on, nyeg! You know what? This little house is for you: our very first house. Put it down at your home and let one of your guhs live in it. Then come and tell me!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.hint.bewoner: put the small Guh House down at your home, let one of your guhs live in it and tell the Carpenter Guh
quest.guhs.timmerguh.bewoner_nog: Is a guh living in your house yet? Put it down, right-click it and choose New Resident (or right-click it while carrying a guh). Then come and tell me, nyeg!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.klaar: A guh lives in our house! WAHOOG! You're now a real carpenter guh. Here: my building booklet (it has all three Guh Houses in it: small, medium and large), another little house as a gift and a little carpenter's helmet for your guh!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.knus_tip: Want to make the house even cozier? Put a toy (a slide, a seesaw, a swing, a tunnel or a nibble ball) and a guh lamp by your house, in the home area. Then I'll have something nice for you!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.knus_klaar: A toy and a guh lamp: how COZY! That makes your guhs so chonky happy. Here, my very own tool belt, with a little hammer and a folding ruler. Tap tap, nyeg!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.boekje_kwijt: Lost my building booklet? No worries, I've got another one. Here, nyeg!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.bedankt0: Tap tap, nyeg! How are your houses doing? Still cozy?
quest.guhs.timmerguh.bedankt1: You know the best thing about a guh house? The ears. Always the ears. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.bedankt2: Building together is twice as chonky! Will you come help again? There's always a roof to do.
quest.guhs.timmerguh.niks: Tap tap... huh? My blueprint is missing, and I can't remember where the roof goes. Come back in a bit, nyeg!
block.guhs.baltoguh_beeldje.lore: A bronze Baltoguh on a snowy pedestal. For the Hero of Nomguh. Click: awooo!
item.guhs.baltoguh_beeldje.lore: A bronze Baltoguh on a snowy pedestal. For the Hero of Nomguh. Click: awooo!
block.guhs.baltoguh_beeldje.klik: "...But maybe, just maybe... a Baltoguh can." Awooo-nyeg!
block.guhs.nomguh_routepaal.lore: Red and white, with a glowing guh ear on top: you'll never get lost in the snowstorm.
item.guhs.nomguh_routepaal.lore: Red and white, with a glowing guh ear on top: you'll never get lost in the snowstorm.
block.guhs.nomguh_medicijnkist.lore: The medicine for the baby guhs of Nomguh. Take good care of it, nyeg!
item.guhs.nomguh_medicijnkist.lore: The medicine for the baby guhs of Nomguh. Take good care of it, nyeg!
block.guhs.sneeuwguhspar_zaailing.lore: A teeny-tiny spruce with a little snow cap. Grows into a real snowguh spruce!
item.guhs.sneeuwguhspar_zaailing.lore: A teeny-tiny spruce with a little snow cap. Grows into a real snowguh spruce!
structure.guhs.nomguh.tooltip: The snowy guh town in the middle of the Snowguh Tundra: Baltoguh, Boris, Rosy and the trek through the storm
gui.guhs.balto.niet_bouwen: Nomguh is so pretty and snowy, nyeg! No building or breaking here.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.baltoguh: Rarity: One per player, after the story of Nomguh
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.baltoguh: Half guh, half wolf: gray fur, pointy wolf ears, a pale belly and a real guh snoot. Once a bit of an outsider, now the hero of Nomguh. In the snow he runs super wahoog (even when you ride him), and with the Sniff! button in the guh menu he sniffs out the way to your house or your spawn point: follow the glowing pawprints! Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.boris: Rarity: One, on Nomguh's old boat
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.boris: A real goose (not a guh!) with a fur hat and a Russian accent. Da, little guh... honk! He lives with Baltoguh on the old boat in the frozen bay and always knows what to do. His wisdom: a guh doesn't only think with his paws, but with his heart too.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.steele_mika: Rarity: One, at Nomguh's starting line
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.steele_mika: Nomguh's show-off champion sled leader, with a red racing cap, goggles and a gold medal. I'M the fastest, nyeh-heh! He always wants the glory, but everybody just giggles at him sweetly. After the story you can race him along the route.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.muk: A big, sweet polar bear guh with a blue scarf. Muk talks for two (because Luk never says anything) and loves fishing in the little ice pond. Cuddles are free!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.luk: A big, sweet polar bear guh with a green scarf and a little fishing rod. Luk never says anything, but nods, waves and cuddles all the more. Muk translates.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.rosy: Rarity: One, in Nomguh's little hospital
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.rosy: A little pink baby guh in a tiny bed, with a yellow scarf and a red nose. She had the nibble cough and sneezed super cutely (achoo-nyeg!). Thanks to the medicine chest from the mountain hut she's all better again.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.witte_wolfguh: Rarity: Only at the darkest moment of the journey
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.witte_wolfguh: A white wolf guh who glows softly, like a little star in the snow. She only appears when it's darkest, and looks at you very kindly. Then she's gone... but you'll never forget her.
gui.guhs.balto.balto.naar_rosy: Go see Rosy at the little hospital: the white house with the pink heart. I can smell her sneezing, nyeg.
gui.guhs.balto.balto.naar_boris: Boris always knows what to do. He's on our boat, just over there. Honk, he'll say.
gui.guhs.balto.balto.onderweg: Hup hup! We're on our way, follow the red posts!
gui.guhs.balto.balto.naar_rosy_kist: Quick, bring the medicine chest to Rosy! I'll run with you, nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.balto.klaar.0: Everyone calls me a hero now. I'm just... Baltoguh. But a WAHOOG one, nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.balto.klaar.1: Smell that? Hot cocoa on the town square. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.balto.klaar.2: Half guh, half wolf. Just right the way I am.
gui.guhs.balto.balto.na_temmen.0: How's the Baltoguh at your place doing? Give him a pat from me, nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.balto.na_temmen.1: I'm staying here on the boat, with Boris. But you're always welcome!
gui.guhs.balto.boris.nieuw: Honk! A new face! Go say hello to Baltoguh, da? He's out there on the ice.
gui.guhs.balto.boris.eerst_rosy: Rosy is sick, yes? Check on her at the little hospital first, little guh. Then we talk. Honk.
gui.guhs.balto.boris.ga: What are you waiting for? Baltoguh is ready by the boat. Honk honk!
gui.guhs.balto.boris.onderweg: Honk! Go, go! Follow the posts, da?
gui.guhs.balto.boris.naar_rosy: Not to me, to Rosy with that chest! Honk!
gui.guhs.balto.boris.klaar.0: Da, didn't I tell you? But maybe, just maybe... a Baltoguh can. Honk!
gui.guhs.balto.boris.klaar.1: Want flying lessons? Just kidding, honk. I hardly ever fly myself.
gui.guhs.balto.boris.klaar.2: A goose always has cold feet. That's why I stand on one leg. Honk.
gui.guhs.balto.boris.klaar.3: My little hat? From my granny. From the far east, da.
gui.guhs.balto.steele.begin.0: Nyeh-heh! I am Steele Mika, the fastest sled leader in all of Nomguh. And you are... nobody.
gui.guhs.balto.steele.begin.1: That little wolf guh? He couldn't even pull a tiny sled of nibbles. Nyeh-heh!
gui.guhs.balto.steele.begin.2: See my medal? Gold. Just like my fur. Well, almost.
gui.guhs.balto.steele.storm: To the mountain hut? In THIS storm? My gorgeous fur would get wet, nyeh. You do it.
gui.guhs.balto.steele.onderweg: I'd be much faster, of course. But I had to brush my fur.
gui.guhs.balto.steele.eer: Er... the chest? Well, I was obviously going to... never mind. Go on. Quick.
gui.guhs.balto.steele.klaar.0: Hmph. I could have done it too, nyeh-heh. But I was busy. With my fur.
gui.guhs.balto.steele.klaar.1: Want to race? Then you'll see who's really the fastest! (Nyeh.)
gui.guhs.balto.steele.klaar.2: That Baltoguh... eh, he's pretty okay. Don't tell anyone.
gui.guhs.balto.muk.0: Hi! I'm Muk, and that's Luk. Luk says: hi! (Luk waves.)
gui.guhs.balto.muk.1: We fish little guhfish out of the ice here. Luk catches more, but I count better!
gui.guhs.balto.muk.2: Brrr? Nope, we're never cold. We're polar bear guhs! Cuddle?
gui.guhs.balto.muk.klaar.0: You're a hero! Luk thinks so too. (Luk nods really hard.)
gui.guhs.balto.muk.klaar.1: Rosy is all better! Luk cried happy tears. Me too, a little.
gui.guhs.balto.muk.klaar.2: Want to come ice fishing sometime? Luk will lend you his little fishing rod!
gui.guhs.balto.luk.1: (Luk nods. Then he nods once more, just to be sure.)
gui.guhs.balto.luk.2: (Luk gives you a big polar bear hug. So warm!)
gui.guhs.balto.luk.3: (Luk proudly shows you his little fishing rod. There's a sock hanging on it.)
gui.guhs.balto.rosy.nieuw: Achoo! Oh, hi. Who are you? Are you Baltoguh's buddy? Achoo-nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.rosy.wachten.0: Achoo! Will you hurry back with the medicine? I'll wait here. In my little bed. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.balto.rosy.wachten.1: Nurse Snuggles says I'm brave. Achoo! Are you brave too?
gui.guhs.balto.rosy.beter.0: I'm all better again! Can I ride on your shoulders? WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.balto.rosy.beter.1: When I grow up, I'm going to be a sled guh. Just like Baltoguh!
gui.guhs.balto.rosy.beter.2: My little nose works again: I can smell hot cocoa! Nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.wolf.0: (The White Wolf Guh gives you a soft look. It makes your heart all warm.)
gui.guhs.balto.wolf.1: (She says nothing. But you know exactly what she means.)
gui.guhs.balto.wolf.2: (Snowflakes dance around her, like little stars.)
gui.guhs.balto.slee_niet: Nyeg... the sled can't leave right now (are you still busy, or is there no Nomguh nearby?).
gui.guhs.balto.moment.start: Go, Baltoguh! The trip to the mountain hut begins. Follow the red posts with the little lights!
gui.guhs.balto.moment.te_laat: Nyeg, once more! Too late... but Rosy is brave and will wait a little longer. Try again!
gui.guhs.balto.moment.gestopt: The trip has stopped. Baltoguh is waiting for you at the old boat. Shall we try again?
gui.guhs.balto.moment.storm_klaart_op: The storm is clearing... Baltoguh knows the way again! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.balto.held: ✿ %s is the Hero of Nomguh! Rosy is better, and all the guhs are singing. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.balto.getemd: Baltoguh is coming with you! He can sniff out the way to your house: press Sniff! in his guh menu!
gui.guhs.balto.hint.rosy: Go to Rosy at Nomguh's little hospital (the white house with the pink heart)
gui.guhs.balto.hint.boris: Ask Boris for advice: the goose on the old boat in the frozen bay
gui.guhs.balto.hint.start: Talk to Baltoguh at the old boat: off to the mountain hut!
gui.guhs.balto.hint.kist: Bring the medicine chest to Rosy at the little hospital
gui.guhs.balto.hint.tem: Baltoguh wants to come with you: talk to him at the old boat
gui.guhs.balto.scene.ontmoet.1: By an old boat on the ice sits a gray guh with pointy wolf ears. He looks a little shy.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.ontmoet.2: Oh! Hi... I'm Baltoguh. Half guh, half wolf. The other guhs think I'm a little... weird. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.ontmoet.3: Nyeh-heh! Look, it's the little wolf guh! In Nomguh only REAL sled guhs pull the sled. Like ME!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.ontmoet.4: ...I'm sure he doesn't mean it. I think. But you know what? Something's wrong at the little hospital. I can smell it.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.ontmoet.5: The baby guhs are sick, and Rosy most of all. Will you go check on her? It's the white house with the pink heart.
gui.guhs.balto.optie.ontmoet: Of course! I'll go see Rosy.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.rosy.1: In the little hospital, the baby guhs lie in their cradles, sniffling softly. Rosy lies by the window.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.rosy.2: Achoo-nyeg! Oh, hi! I'm Rosy. I've got the nibble cough... My little nose is all red.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.rosy.3: The medicine is all gone, nyeg. The new medicine chest is in the mountain hut, high up on the Nomguh Peaks. And a snowstorm is coming...
gui.guhs.balto.scene.rosy.4: Will you go get it? Then I'll get better and I can go sledding again! Achoo!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.rosy.5: Who knows the way through the storm? Maybe Boris, the goose on the old boat. He always knows what to do.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.boris.1: Honk! Da, little guh... Rosy is sick, yes? I heard already. It made my feathers stand on end.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.boris.2: Listen closely. The way to the mountain hut is marked with red posts with a little light. Follow the posts, da?
gui.guhs.balto.scene.boris.3: Along the way: Storm Valley, the Ice Bridge over the Gorge and Avalanche Mountain. Stay in the middle, and rest at the fire baskets.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.boris.4: And take Baltoguh with you. Everyone thinks he's only half a guh... but his nose is the best in Nomguh.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.boris.5: Remember: a guh doesn't just think with his pawsies, but with his little heart too. Honk honk!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.start.1: Boris told you, huh? I'll pull the sled, you steer. Together we'll get the medicine for Rosy!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.berghut.1: The mountain hut! It's nice and warm inside. On the table sits the medicine chest, with a little pink heart on the lid.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.berghut.2: Sniff sniff... this is it! Hold on tight. Now hurry back to Rosy, before the storm gets even worse!
gui.guhs.balto.optie.berghut: Grab the medicine chest and head back!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.wolf.1: The storm is too strong. You can't see the posts anymore. Baltoguh sniffs... but all he smells is snow. He's lost the way. Nyeg...
gui.guhs.balto.scene.wolf.2: I... I don't know anymore. Maybe they're right. Maybe I'm only half a guh.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.wolf.3: Then, all of a sudden, a white wolf guh stands among the snowflakes. She glows softly, like a little star, and looks at Baltoguh very kindly.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.wolf.4: An ordinary guh can't make this journey alone...
gui.guhs.balto.scene.wolf.5: But maybe, just maybe... a Baltoguh can.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.wolf.6: I'm half guh... and half wolf. And that's just right. AWOOO-NYEG!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.aankomst.1: There's Nomguh! All the lights are on. The guhs are cheering by the stable.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.aankomst.2: Er... yes! Well done, really. I showed them the way, of course. With my... er... gorgeous fur. Nyeh-heh?
gui.guhs.balto.scene.aankomst.3: All the guhs look at Steele Mika... and then they start to giggle. Hee hee hee, nyeg! Even Steele Mika has to laugh a little.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.aankomst.4: One last bit! Bring the medicine chest to Rosy at the little hospital!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.feest.1: You set the medicine chest next to Rosy's little bed. Nurse Snuggles gives every baby guh a spoonful of nibble syrup.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.feest.2: Mmm, it tastes like strawberry cheese! ...Hey! My little nose works again! I'm better! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.feest.3: You did it! No... WE did it. Together. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.feest.4: Everyone in Nomguh now calls you the Hero of Nomguh. And Baltoguh? He'll never be the odd one out again.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.feest.5: Honk! What did I tell you, da? But maybe, just maybe... a Baltoguh can!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.tem.1: You know... I'd like to come with you. To your house. Is that okay? I can always sniff my way back, nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.optie.tem_nee: Stay in Nomguh a little longer.
gui.guhs.balto.snuffel.tooltip: Baltoguh sniffs out the way to your house (or your spawn point). Follow the glowing pawprints!
gui.guhs.balto.snuffel.huisje: Sniff sniff! %1$s smells your house: %2$s more blocks to the %3$s. Follow the pawprints, nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.snuffel.spawn: Sniff sniff! %1$s smells your bed: %2$s more blocks to the %3$s. Follow the pawprints!
gui.guhs.balto.snuffel.al_thuis.huisje: Sniff... %s wags: you're already at your house! Nyeg.
gui.guhs.balto.snuffel.al_thuis.spawn: Sniff... %s wags: you're already home! Nyeg.
gui.guhs.balto.snuffel.andere_wereld: Sniff sniff... %s can smell your home, but it's in another world. Nyeg!
Find Nomguh, the snowy guh town in the middle of the Snowguh Tundra

Say hello to both polar bear guhs (Luk doesn't say anything back)
advancements.guhs.verhalen.balto_tocht.d: Set off through the snowstorm to the mountain hut
advancements.guhs.verhalen.balto_berghut: Grab the Medicine Chest in the mountain hut on the Nomguh Peaks
advancements.guhs.verhalen.balto_wolf.de: Howl along with Baltoguh at the darkest point of the trek
advancements.guhs.verhalen.balto_aankoms: Get back to Nomguh in time (Steele Mika wants the credit, everyone giggles)
advancements.guhs.verhalen.balto_held.de: Bring the medicine to Rosy and become the Hero of Nomguh

advancements.guhs.verhalen.balto_snuffel: Let your Baltoguh sniff out the way to your house
advancements.guhs.verhalen.balto_sneeuws: Ride your Baltoguh super wahoog-fast through the snow
advancements.guhs.verhalen.balto_beeldje: Put your Baltoguh Statuette down somewhere
advancements.guhs.verhalen.balto_outfits: Unlock the red scarf, the wolf ears, the snow hat and the mittens
advancements.guhs.verhalen.balto_slee_to: With Baltoguh and the guh sled pups, get the medicine to Nomguh's little hospital in time
advancements.guhs.verhalen.balto_slee_ru: Rest a moment with your sled pups by a fire basket along the way
advancements.guhs.verhalen.balto_slee_ij: Get across a whole ice bridge with the sled without flomping off
advancements.guhs.verhalen.balto_slee_la: Out of the Way, Just in Time!

advancements.guhs.verhalen.balto_slee_st: Win the sled sprint against Steele Mika (he says it was the wind)
advancements.guhs.verhalen.balto_slee_la: Win the sled sprint on hard. Steele Mika turns all pink
advancements.guhs.verhalen.balto_slee_wi: Buy something pretty for your sleigh bells from Steele Mika
item.guhs.sneeuwslee.lore: Your own sled with four guh sled pups. Go, go, through the snow!
item.guhs.sneeuwslee.lore2: Place it on snow or ice · W: go go · S: brake · A/D: steer · sneak + right-click: pick up
item.guhs.sledebelletje.lore: Ding-a-ling! Earned in the Nomguh Sled Sprint. Steele Mika trades them for wintry goodies.
item.guhs.baltoslee_sneeuwguh.lore: A snowman, but a guh. With a carrot snoot and a little scarf. Brrr-nyeg!
item.guhs.baltoslee_minislee.lore: A little sled with a red blankie. You can sit in it!
item.guhs.baltoslee_sledebellen.lore: Tap it: ding-a-ling-a-ling! Just like the Nomguh sled.
item.guhs.baltoslee_beker.lore: The golden cup of the fastest sled guh. With guh ears, of course.
item.guhs.baltoslee_hondenmand.lore: A warm basket with a cushion and a bone-shaped cheese nibble. For tired pawsies.
item.guhs.baltoslee_lantaarnpaal.lore: One of those lanterns that shows the sled route through the storm. Warm light, little snow cap on top.
subtitles.guhs.baltoslee.glijden: Sled runners glide over the snow
gui.guhs.baltoslee.tocht.start: Baltoguh and the guh sled pups are ready. Through the snowstorm to the mountain hut, grab the medicine chest, then back to the little hospital as fast as you can. Rosy is counting on you!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.sprint.start: The Nomguh Sled Sprint (%s): to the mountain hut, around it, and back to the starting line. Faster than Steele Mika?
gui.guhs.baltoslee.besturing: W: hup hup, faster! · S: brake · A/D: steer · Hold Shift: stop. Follow Baltoguh's glowing sniff stars when you can't see a thing.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.gestopt: You stopped. The sled pups take you back to the stable. Nyeg, another time!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.rust.hint: A fire basket! Brake (S) and stand still for a bit to warm your pawsies.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.koud.uitleg: Watch the warmth bar: the pawsies get cold along the way. Stop at a fire basket at least once (S), or the sled pups start to dawdle. And steer into the gusts of wind!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.koud.bijna: The pawsies are getting cold! Warm them at a fire basket, nyeg.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.koud.traag: Brr, cold pawsies! The sled pups are dawdling. Stop at the next fire basket (S), nyeg!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.rust.tocht: Baltoguh and the sled pups warm their pawsies at the fire basket. Everyone gets a cuddle and a warm cheese nibble. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.rust.sprint: Warming up at the fire basket... warm paws are fast paws!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.ijsbrug: The ice bridge! Steer gently, it's slippery...
gui.guhs.baltoslee.plof.sub: Off the ice bridge into the soft snow. No harm done, try again!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.lawine.ontweken: Dodged the avalanche just in time! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.lawine.bedolven: Snowed in! The sled pups are digging you out...
gui.guhs.baltoslee.terug: The medicine chest is on the sled! Now back to the little hospital, and fast: you have %s.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.dieptepunt.sub: The storm is too strong. Where is Baltoguh?
gui.guhs.baltoslee.helder: The storm is calming down... you can see the lights of Nomguh again!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.aankomst.sub: %s to spare. The medicine is here!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.aankomst.uitleg: The little hospital! Baltoguh and the sled pups brought the medicine just in time. Rosy sneezes one more time, super cutely... and then she smiles. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.te_laat.uitleg: Nyeg, once more! Luckily Rosy is still sneezing away quite cheerfully, and the sled pups would love another lap. Just try again.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.sprint.keer: Around the mountain hut! Now back to the starting line!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.sprint.uitslag: Sled Sprint (%1$s): %2$s. You get %3$s sleigh bells. Avalanches dodged: %4$s, snowed in: %5$s.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.start: Nyeh-heh! I am the fastest sled leader in all of Nomguh. Try and keep up!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.ingehaald: Hey! That's... that's not allowed! Just you wait!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.eerst: FIRST! Naturally. Nyeh-heh! (He polishes his little cap.)
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.gewonnen: Nyeh-heh! Told you: I'M the fastest! But... you did quite well. A little. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.verloren: What?! That was the wind! And the snow! And... my sled pups weren't wearing their socks!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.uitgelachen: All the guhs of Nomguh giggle sweetly. Steele Mika turns a little pink. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.al_onderweg: You're already on your way, aren't you? Nyeh-heh, hup hup!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.geen_route: Nyeg... the route is completely snowed under. Come back later.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.nog_niet: You? Race against ME? Nyeh-heh-heh! First go through the storm for real, like that Baltoguh. Then we'll talk. (My little shop is open, though.)
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.welkom: Well, well. Brave enough to take on the champion? To the mountain hut, around it and back. Your best times: easy %1$s · medium %2$s · hard %3$s.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.uitleg: Listen closely, because I'll only say this once. Hup-hup (W) is faster, brake (S), steer (A/D). Gusts of wind push you off the route: steer into them. Rumbling avalanche? Steer to the OTHER side of the route! The ice bridge is slippery: take it slow. And cold paws are slow paws: you have to stop at a fire basket at least once along the way. Not that it'll help, because I'M winning anyway. Nyeh-heh!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.vast: Snowed in! The sled pups are digging... woof-nyeg!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.berghut: The mountain hut: Baltoguh grabs the medicine chest... (%s)
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.dieptepunt: The storm is too strong... where is Baltoguh? (%s)
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.rust: Warm pawsies at the fire basket... (%s)
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.lawine_rechts: ⚠ AVALANCHE from the left! Steer right ⇨
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.lawine_links: ⇦ Steer left! AVALANCHE from the right ⚠
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.lawine_veilig: Good, stay there! The avalanche is coming...
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.ijsbrug: Ice bridge: steer gently, don't go over the edge!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.vuurkorf: Fire basket! Brake (S) to warm up
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.diep: Deep snow! Back to the middle
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.koud: Cold pawsies: the pups are dawdling! Stop at a fire basket (S)
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.koud_bijna: The pawsies are getting cold! Warm them at a fire basket, nyeg
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.toetsen: W: hup hup · S: brake · A/D: steer · Hold Shift: stop
gui.guhs.baltoslee.eigen.uitleg: Your very own snow sled! W: hup hup, S: brake, A/D: steer. The guh sled pups only run on snow and ice. Sneak + right-click to pick it up, and give them a cheese nibble now and then!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.eigen.geen_sneeuw: The sled pups want snow under their pawsies, nyeg!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.eigen.niet_van_jou: This isn't your sled. The sled pups give you a sweet but stern look.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.eigen.knabbel: Woof-nyeg! The sled pups are super happy with their cheese nibble.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.eigen.geen_plek: The sled doesn't fit there. Find an open spot (preferably with snow)!
structure.guhs.kloon_eiland.tooltip: A rocky island in the Deep Guh Sea, with a lab under a glass dome and an arena on top
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.mewtwo: Rarity: One per player (after the story of Clone Island)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.mewtwo: Professor Nibbleclone wanted to clone a guh that could eat twice as many cheese nibbles. It didn't turn into a clone, but something new: the Guhtwo! Light gray-purple, with a purple tail with a little bulb and a tube from the back of his head to his neck, but with chubby guh cheeks and guh ears. He floats a little above the ground in a soft purple glow, floats over small gaps with you on his back, pulls cheese nibbles and bits and bobs within 8 blocks toward him with nibble telekinesis, and eats everything x2: double hearts from every snack! One per player, after the story of Clone Island. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.mew: Rarity: Only around Clone Island (after the story)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.mew: A teeny-tiny pink floating little guh with big blue eyes and a long thin tail with a little bulb. Mewguh giggles at everything, does little somersaults in the air and is the Guhtwo's best friend. She only lives around Clone Island and only shows herself once you know the story of the Clone Tank. You can't tame her (she belongs to everyone), but you can wave! Hee hee, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.knabbelkloon: Rarity: One (in his little office on Clone Island)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.knabbelkloon: Professor Nibbleclone is the smartest and most scatterbrained guh of the Guh Sea. His glasses are always crooked, his lab coat is full of nibble juice stains and his notes are everywhere. He wanted to clone a guh that eats twice as many cheese nibbles... and in a very strange way, it worked. Nyeg!
block.guhs.mewtwo_kloontank.lore: Professor Nibbleclone's big glass tank, full of bubbling pink nibble juice.
item.guhs.mewtwo_kloontank.lore: Professor Nibbleclone's big glass tank, full of bubbling pink nibble juice.
block.guhs.mewtwo_knabbelschaal.lore: A gigantic bowl for a DOUBLE helping. Fits exactly 32 cheese nibbles. Or more.
item.guhs.mewtwo_knabbelschaal.lore: A gigantic bowl for a DOUBLE helping. Fits exactly 32 cheese nibbles. Or more.
block.guhs.mewtwo_computer.lore: An old lab computer with a blinking little guh face on the screen. Bleep-nyeg!
item.guhs.mewtwo_computer.lore: An old lab computer with a blinking little guh face on the screen. Bleep-nyeg!
block.guhs.mewtwo_reageerbuisjes.lore: Pink, purple and lilac nibble juice in little tubes. Don't drink it! (Unless you're double hungry.)
item.guhs.mewtwo_reageerbuisjes.lore: Pink, purple and lilac nibble juice in little tubes. Don't drink it! (Unless you're double hungry.)
block.guhs.mewtwo_papieren.lore: Full of scribbles, formulas and drawings of cheese nibbles. Very important. Probably.
item.guhs.mewtwo_papieren.lore: Full of scribbles, formulas and drawings of cheese nibbles. Very important. Probably.
item.guhs.mewtwo_labnotitie.lore: Right-click to read. A scribble by Professor Nibbleclone.
item.guhs.mewtwo_tankonderdeel.lore: Fit it into the clone tank in the dome hall (right-click the tank).
item.guhs.mewtwo_trainerpetje.lore: With our very own logo: the nibble ball with guh ears. I choose you, nyeg!
item.guhs.mewtwo_trainerpakje.lore: A lilac trainer vest and a little backpack with a nibble ball on it.
item.guhs.mewtwo_staartje.lore: A soft purple tail with a little ball and a neck tube. Now you're a little bit Guhtwo too!
item.guhs.mew_ballonnetje.lore: A pink balloon that looks like Mewguh. It giggles when the wind blows. Hee hee!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.telekinese.tooltip: Nibble telekinesis on or off: pulls cheese nibbles and items within 8 blocks toward him (and toward you)
gui.guhs.mewtwo.telekinese.aan: %s turns on nibble telekinesis: everything within 8 blocks floats over to you! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.telekinese.uit: %s takes a break from telekinesis. He'll just leave everything where it is, nyeg.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.kopie.mokt: ...Nyeg. (The Guhtwo turns away and floats back and forth a little sadly.)
gui.guhs.mewtwo.kopie.honger: A meal? For me? Double? ...My tummy says yes. Very loudly. GRRRUMBLE.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.kopie.al_getemd: You already have a Guhtwo with you! I'll stay here, with Mewguh. Say hi from me. x2!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.kopie.getemd_hier: Will you come visit again? Mewguh and I will save a double helping for you. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tem.vraag: You helped me. May I... come with you? Then I'll never be alone again. And I eat very neatly. Double neatly.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tem.gelukt: The Guhtwo floats happily over to you: he's yours now! He eats everything x2. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tem.later: Okay. I'll wait here. Floating. Hungry. (He winks.)
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.1: Oh! A visitor! Welcome to my Clone Island! I'm Professor Nibbleclone. Don't mind the mess. Or the pink puddles.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.2: I had a dream: a guh who can eat TWICE as many cheese nibbles. So I tried to clone one, in my beautiful clone tank.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.3: But something went wrong. There was a BOOM, the tank cracked, and all my lab notes flew all over the lab! Now I don't even remember what happened exactly. Nyeg...
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.4: Will you find my six lab notes? They're everywhere: in my little office, in the dome hall, in the tower and by the jetty. Then we'll read together what happened!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.later: No problem! Meanwhile I'll go look for my glasses. They're probably crooked again. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.zoek: You have %1$s of the 6 lab notes! There are %2$s more somewhere on the island: look %3$s.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.notities.1: All six! What a super sniffer you are. Let's read... hmm, day 45... BOOM... Oh! Now I remember!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.notities.2: It didn't become a clone. It became something new: the Guhtwo! And he CAN eat twice as much. So my wish came true after all, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.notities.3: But he got such a fright from the bang, and from his own hunger, that he went to sulk up in the arena. Poor guh.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.notities.4: If we repair the clone tank, something lovely is bound to happen. Four parts are missing. They're in the parts crates: in the boathouse, in my little office, in the tower and in the stands.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.notities.5: Here, a present for my best lab assistant: a real trainer cap, with our very own logo! Install the parts at the tank in the dome hall.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.onderdelen: %1$s more parts for the clone tank. You have %2$s with you: install them at the tank in the dome hall!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.maaltijd: A DOUBLE helping for the big nibble bowl in the arena: %1$s more cheese nibbles and %2$s tasty snacks. Guhtwo and Mewguh are waiting!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.klaar: Just look at them, Guhtwo and Mewguh: best buddies! And you're the best lab assistant I've ever had. My glasses are even straight. Almost.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.klaar_niet_getemd: Guhtwo is waiting for you up in the arena. I think he wants to ask you something... Nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.notitie.al: You already have this lab note. There's a cheese nibble doodle on the back.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.notitie.alle: All six lab notes! Bring them to Professor Nibbleclone in his little office.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.kist.gevonden: %s found! Install it at the clone tank in the dome hall.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.kist.al: This crate is empty. You already have the part!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.kist.nog_niet: A crate full of little screws and tubes... but which part do you need? Ask Professor Nibbleclone first.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.kist.klaar: An empty crate. The clone tank is already fully repaired, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tank.kapot: The clone tank is cracked. Pink nibble juice is dripping out. Professor Nibbleclone surely knows what needs fixing.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tank.mist: %s parts are still missing. Look for them in the parts crates on the island.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tank.heel: The clone tank bubbles cheerfully. Blub, blub, nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tank.scene.1: (The last part clicks into place. The tank fills with pink nibble juice. Blub... blub... BLUBBLUB!)
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tank.scene.3: That... that's Mewguh! The very first pink guhling, they say. She came to see what all the bubbling was about!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tank.scene.4: Guhtwo is still sad. And what ALWAYS helps when you're sad? Exactly: a big nibble meal. A DOUBLE helping!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tank.scene.5: Bring 32 cheese nibbles and 2 tasty snacks to the big nibble bowl in the arena. Here, put on this trainer outfit: then you'll look very official!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.schaal.nog_niet: A big empty bowl. Who could it be for? (Talk to Professor Nibbleclone first.)
gui.guhs.mewtwo.schaal.erin: In the bowl: %1$s of %2$s cheese nibbles and %3$s of %4$s snacks.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.schaal.meer: %1$s more cheese nibbles and %2$s snacks for a double helping!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.schaal.klaar: A bowl full of yum! Guhtwo and Mewguh have already feasted. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.maal.scene.1: Is that... all for me? A DOUBLE helping?
gui.guhs.mewtwo.maal.scene.2: Hee hee! Together! Let's munch together!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.maal.scene.3: (Guhtwo and Mewguh munch away together at the big nibble bowl. Nibble nibble, x2! x2!)
gui.guhs.mewtwo.maal.scene.4: I thought I was weird, because I want to eat twice as much. But eating twice as much... is actually pretty wahoog.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.maal.scene.5: Mewguh says I'm her best buddy. And you're my buddy too. Will you... come see me in a bit? I want to ask you something. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.maal.cadeau: Giggling, Mewguh gives you a little balloon that looks just like her, and Guhtwo gives you a soft little tail. Click the Guhtwo in the arena!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.mew.zwaai: Mewguh does a little somersault in the air and waves at you. Hee hee, nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.niet_bouwen: No remodeling, nyeg! This is Professor Nibbleclone's lab (he can barely find his stuff as it is).
gui.guhs.mewtwo.klaar: The story of Clone Island is complete! The Guhtwo may now come with you (one time only). WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.notitie.1: Day 1. My big plan: a guh who can eat TWICE as many cheese nibbles. Why? Because I can. And because then I'll never have to clear away leftovers again. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.notitie.2: Day 12. The recipe: one tuft of guh fluff, a splash of pink nibble juice and lots and lots of love. The clone tank bubbles cheerfully. I've lost my glasses three times already.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.notitie.3: Day 30. A little pink guhling is floating around the island. She giggles every time I drop something (so, very often). She looks like a very old drawing... Mewguh?
gui.guhs.mewtwo.notitie.4: Day 44. Oops. I accidentally put DOUBLE nibble juice in the tank. Now it's bubbling... purple? That wasn't in the recipe. Or was it? I can't find my recipe.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.notitie.5: Day 45. BOOM! The tank cracked! Out stepped a light purple guh, with a tail with a little ball on the end and a tube in his neck. He looked at me and said: 'Nyeg...?'
gui.guhs.mewtwo.notitie.6: Day 46. He ate ALL the cheese nibbles on the island. Twice as many! My wish came true, WAHOOG! But he looks so sad. He sits up in the arena and doesn't want to see anyone.
item.guhs.mewtwo_tankonderdeel.1.lore: A curved piece of glass that fits the clone tank exactly. Careful, don't drop it!
item.guhs.mewtwo_tankonderdeel.2.lore: A shiny copper tube. Soon the nibble juice will flow through here.
item.guhs.mewtwo_tankonderdeel.3.lore: A little pump that goes blubblubblub. No bubbles, no happy tank!
item.guhs.mewtwo_tankonderdeel.4.lore: A bottle full of pink, fragrant nibble juice. Smells like cheese and strawberry. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.zoek.1: You have %1$s of the 6 lab notes! There are %2$s more somewhere on the island. Have a look on the professor's desk. I always put things down there... I think. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.plek.notitie.2: among the books in the little office
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.zoek.2: You have %1$s of the 6 lab notes! There are %2$s more somewhere on the island. Have a look among the books in the little office. I always put things down there... I think. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.plek.notitie.3: by a computer in the dome hall
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.zoek.3: You have %1$s of the 6 lab notes! There are %2$s more somewhere on the island. Have a look by a computer in the dome hall. I always put things down there... I think. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.zoek.4: You have %1$s of the 6 lab notes! There are %2$s more somewhere on the island. Have a look next to the clone tank. I always put things down there... I think. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.plek.notitie.5: at the top of the tower stairs
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.zoek.5: You have %1$s of the 6 lab notes! There are %2$s more somewhere on the island. Have a look at the top of the tower stairs. I always put things down there... I think. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.plek.notitie.6: in the boathouse by the jetty
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.zoek.6: You have %1$s of the 6 lab notes! There are %2$s more somewhere on the island. Have a look in the boathouse by the jetty. I always put things down there... I think. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.plek.onderdeel.1: in the boathouse by the jetty
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.onderdelen_zoek.1: %1$s more parts for the clone tank. Have a look in the parts crate in the boathouse by the jetty!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.onderdelen_zoek.2: %1$s more parts for the clone tank. Have a look in the parts crate in the little office!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.onderdelen_zoek.3: %1$s more parts for the clone tank. Have a look in the parts crate halfway up the tower stairs!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.plek.onderdeel.4: in the stands of the arena
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.onderdelen_zoek.4: %1$s more parts for the clone tank. Have a look in the parts crate in the stands of the arena!
advancements.guhs.verhalen.mewtwo_eiland: Find the rocky island with the lab under the glass dome, somewhere in the Deep Guh Sea
advancements.guhs.verhalen.mewtwo_welkom: Promise Professor Nibbleclone you'll look for his six lab notes
advancements.guhs.verhalen.mewtwo_notiti: Find all six lab notes and read what happened to the clone tank
advancements.guhs.verhalen.mewtwo_tank.d: Fit the four parts into the cracked clone tank
advancements.guhs.verhalen.mewtwo_mew.de: Meet Mewguh, Clone Island's tiny pink floating guhling
advancements.guhs.verhalen.mewtwo_maalti: Fill the big nibble bowl in the arena: Guhtwo and Mewguh feast together and become best buddies
advancements.guhs.verhalen.mewtwo_getemd: Take Guhtwo along: he floats, pulls cheese nibbles towards himself and eats everything double
advancements.guhs.verhalen.mewtwo_teleki: Let your Guhtwo float a cheese nibble over to himself
advancements.guhs.verhalen.mewtwo_x2.des: Give your Guhtwo a snack: double hearts, x2!
advancements.guhs.verhalen.mewtwo_traine: Collect the whole Clone Island outfit: Trainer Cap, trainer suit, Guhtwo tail and the Little Mewguh Balloon
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.wolkenhoeder: Rarity: One in every Cloud Chapel
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.wolkenhoeder: A soft cloud guh with a golden shepherd's crook and a teeny-tiny halo. He looks after the Snuggleheart and knows exactly what it needs to beat again.
advancements.guhs.verhalen.hemel_kapelle: Find the Cloud Chapel on its floating islet and take the cloud lift up
Talk to the Cloud Shepherd: he watches over the sleeping Snuggleheart
advancements.guhs.verhalen.hemel_hart.de: Bring a guh crystal, a golden cheese nibble and a fluff feather: the Snuggleheart beats again. WAHOOG!
advancements.guhs.verhalen.hemel_terug.d: Let the Snuggleheart bring one of your guhs back from up in the clouds, with all its hearts and its diary
advancements.guhs.verhalen.hemel_ster.de: Bring a Memory star to the Snuggleheart
advancements.guhs.verhalen.hemel_engeltj: Unlock the Golden Halo and the Cloud Wings
item.guhs.herinnering.lore: A glowing little star full of sweet memories. Nyeg <3
item.guhs.herinnering.naar_het_hart: Bring it to the Snuggleheart in the Cloud Chapel (Super Compass, Tales tab).
item.guhs.herinnering.ook_zonder: The Snuggleheart can also bring them back without a little star.
structure.guhs.hemelkapelletje.tooltip: A tiny cloud temple on a floating islet, with the Snuggleheart
gui.guhs.hemel.intro.1: Oh! A visitor, way up here in the clouds... Welcome to the Cloud Chapel, dear guh friend. Nyeg <3
gui.guhs.hemel.intro.2: I'm the Cloud Shepherd. I look after the Snuggleheart: that little pink heart over there, under its glass dome.
gui.guhs.hemel.intro.3: The Snuggleheart can bring guhs who went up to the clouds back home. With all their hearts, their faves, their clothes and their diary!
gui.guhs.hemel.intro.4: But... it's been asleep for a very long time. Zzz... nyeg. To make it beat again, I need three things.
gui.guhs.hemel.intro.5: A guh crystal, for the sparkle. A golden cheese nibble, for the warmth and the chonkiness. And a fluff feather from the Fluff Finches, for the softness.
gui.guhs.hemel.optie.wolkjes: Show me my guhs in the clouds
gui.guhs.hemel.waar: Guh crystals sparkle in the crystal caves of the Guhmension. Golden cheese nibbles fall from the sky during a Cheese Shower, and sometimes they're in the treasure of a cheese nibble nest. Fluff feathers are dropped by the Fluff Finches, in the Guh Fields and the Pink Puffs. Also have a peek in my heaven chest, in the garden!
gui.guhs.hemel.gebracht.kristal: A guh crystal! Look how it sparkles... The Snuggleheart flickers for a moment. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.hemel.gebracht.knabbel: A golden cheese nibble! Mmm, warm and chonky. The Snuggleheart turns a little pinker...
gui.guhs.hemel.gebracht.veertje: A fluff feather! So soft... Do you hear that? Very softly: ba... dum...
gui.guhs.hemel.nog_niks: Have you found anything yet? A guh crystal, a golden cheese nibble or a fluff feather... nyeg.
quest.guhs.next.hemel_zoeken: bring the Cloud Shepherd a guh crystal, a golden cheese nibble and a fluff feather
quest.guhs.next.hemel_terug: talk to the Cloud Shepherd or click the Snuggleheart to bring a guh back from the clouds
gui.guhs.hemel.klopt.1: Look... look! The Snuggleheart is glowing...
gui.guhs.hemel.klopt.2: Ba-dum... ba-dum... IT'S BEATING AGAIN! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.hemel.klopt.3: Thank you so much, dear guh friend. From now on the Snuggleheart can bring all your guhs back from the clouds. For free, as often as you like. Because no one gets forgotten. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.hemel.klopt.4: And for you: a golden halo and cloud wings, for one of your guhs. Then he'll look just like a little cloud guh!
gui.guhs.hemel.klopt.chat: The Snuggleheart is beating again! Click it to see your guhs in the clouds. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.hemel.hoeder.klaar: The Snuggleheart is beating, ba-dum ba-dum. %s of your guhs are up in the clouds. Do you want to see them?
gui.guhs.hemel.hoeder.klaar_leeg: The Snuggleheart is beating, ba-dum ba-dum. All your guhs are with you: no one in the clouds. Lovely, isn't it? Nyeg <3
gui.guhs.hemel.vertel: The Snuggleheart is made of all the cuddles ever given to a guh. That's why it never forgets anyone. When a tame guh goes up to the clouds, a little star stays behind, and his diary stays in your Guhdex. Here the Snuggleheart can bring him back, for free and as often as needed.
gui.guhs.hemel.slaapt: The Snuggleheart is still asleep... zzz. Ask the Cloud Shepherd how to wake it up.
gui.guhs.hemel.ster.leeft: %s has been back for ages! Keep this little star as a sweet memory. Nyeg <3

gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.stitch626: Rarity: One per player, after the story of Guhwai'i
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.stitch626: Experiment 626! A blue alien guh with big ears, four paws and an extra pair of little arms. He was made to be TOO CHONKY... but a guh can never be too chonky: the Chonkiness Scanner goes right off the charts to INCALCULABLY WAHOOG. He makes a mess sometimes, but he never hurts anyone. He climbs up walls, hangs upside down from the ceiling, carries two things at once with his extra arms (double hauling for chores!) and plays the ukulele: "Aloha, nyeg!" After Lilo-guh's story he can be tamed once with a cheese nibble.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.lilo_guh: Rarity: One in every stilt house on Guhwai'i
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.lilo_guh: A small, stubborn guh girl with long black hair, a red dress with white leaves and a pink hibiscus behind her ear. She loves Elvis guh music, surfing and weird blue guhs. She adopted 626-guh from the shelter, because: ohana means family!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.nani_guh: Rarity: One in every stilt house on Guhwai'i
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.nani_guh: Lilo-guh's big sister. She takes care of everyone: Lilo-guh, the house on stilts and now 626-guh too (and his mess). A bit strict, but super sweet. She wears a flower in her bun.

gui.guhs.guhwaii.scanner.meting.4: Too chonky? No such thing. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.scanner.uitslag: ✦ Chonkiness Scanner: the CHONKINESS LEVEL of %s is... INCALCULABLY WAHOOG! The meter went off the charts. ✦

gui.guhs.guhwaii.scanner.bezig: The scanner is still measuring... beep beep!

gui.guhs.guhwaii.ukelele.niet_nu: Blub? (He can't play right now. Later!)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.kokos_onrijp: This coconut is still green. Wait a little longer, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.eitjes_uit: Crack, crack! Tiny little Shellies are hatching from the eggs. Welcome to Guhwai'i!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.intro.1: Aloha! I'm Lilo-guh. Welcome to Guhwai'i! Want a coconut? No? Okay, then I'll eat it myself. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.intro.2: Lilo-guh! Don't talk with your mouth full. Hello, I'm Nani-guh, her big sister.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.intro.3: Last night I saw a shooting star! It fell on top of the hill, with a really loud noise. BOOM!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.intro.4: Nani-guh won't let me go there alone. Will you go take a look? Bring a guh along, that's safer!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.capsule: Have you found the shooting star yet? It's on top of the hill! (Your Super Compass knows the way: Tales tab.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.adoptie.1: A capsule?! With a weird meter inside? And it was... empty? Then I know where that little blue guh came from!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.adoptie.2: This morning there was a little blue guh with four paws and big ears at the shelter. His name is Experiment 626!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.adoptie.3: Lilo-guh... the shelter said he's 'a little wild'. Are you sure?
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.adoptie.4: Super sure! Nobody wants him, so that means I have to have him. From now on his name is 626-guh. Come on, 626-guh!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.adoptie.5: Blub-nyeg! (626-guh runs inside, pulls all the cushions off the couch and knocks over the sand bucket.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.adoptie.6: Oh no, there's mess everywhere! Nothing broken, luckily... Will you help me tidy up? I'm in the kitchen.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.opruimen: 626-guh doesn't mean it, he just doesn't know any better! Will you help Nani-guh tidy up? (%s of %s)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.lief: 626-guh has to learn to be sweet. Show him what sweet is: give him something sweet! He's outside by the shelter.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.klaar.1: 626-guh is the sweetest guh on the whole island. Don't you think? Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.klaar.2: Have you tried the Chonkiness Scanner yet? Every guh is INCALCULABLY WAHOOG. Every single one!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.klaar.3: You know what's the best? Having someone to drink coconut milk with.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.klaar.4: You can go surfing on the other side of the island! Will you come too? I'm there a lot!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.ohana.1: Look at that! 626-guh got a coconut, a flower and cheese nibbles. And he didn't knock anything over!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.ohana.2: Blub... sweet? 626... sweet? (He carefully hugs Lilo-guh with all four of his little arms.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.ohana.3: They said he was made to be TOO CHONKY. But you know what? A guh can never be too chonky!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.ohana.citaat: Ohana means family. Family means nobody gets left behind... or forgotten. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.ohana.4: And now you're part of it too. Thank you, really. Here, something for you: the poster, a ukulele and our island clothes!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.ohana.5: Aloha... NYEG! (626-guh waves with four little arms at once.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.nani.begin: Hi, I'm Nani-guh. Will you keep an eye on Lilo-guh for me? She always has these... ideas.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.nani.opruimen: Will you help? Click the mess away: cushion feathers, a tipped-over bucket, coconut shells... %s to go!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.nani.opgeruimd: All neat again! Nothing's broken, luckily. But 626-guh really does need to learn to be sweet...
gui.guhs.guhwaii.nani.lief: 626-guh loves coconuts, flowers and of course cheese nibbles. Who doesn't?
gui.guhs.guhwaii.nani.ohana: I think Lilo-guh wants to tell you something. Off you go!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.nani.klaar.1: Ever since 626-guh got here, it's never quiet anymore. But it is cozy. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.nani.klaar.2: Want some coconut milk? A coconut and a glass bottle, that's all you need!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.vreemd: Blub-nyeg! (A little blue guh with four little arms looks at you with big eyes and quickly hides something behind his back.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.asiel: Blub? (He presses his nose against the shelter fence. He wants a home so badly.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.rommel: Blub-blub... (He looks at the mess a little guiltily. Just a teeny bit.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.ohana: Ohana? (He tugs at your sleeve, toward Lilo-guh!)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.wat_lief: Blub? (He wants something sweet: a coconut, a pink hibiscus or cheese nibbles.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.al_gehad: Nyeg! (He already has that one. He wants something else sweet!)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.meer_knabbels: Blub! (He points at your cheese nibbles and holds up %s little fingers. With all his little hands.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.gave.kokos: Crack, slurp! (626-guh drinks the coconut empty and hands you back half the shell. As a present.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.gave.bloem: Ooh... (He very carefully tucks the pink hibiscus behind his big ear. He's blushing!)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.gave.knabbels: NOM NOM NOM! (He eats the cheese nibbles with four little hands at once. That's pretty wahoog.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.lief_klaar: 626... sweet! (He gives you a hug. A super soft one. Now hurry to Lilo-guh!)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.getemd: Aloha, nyeg! (626-guh jumps into your arms. He's coming home with you!)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.al_thuis: Aloha! (This 626-guh stays with Lilo-guh. Yours is waiting for you at home!)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.knabbel: Blub? (Give him a cheese nibble, and he'll come with you!)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lijstje: 626-guh wants something sweet: %s a coconut  %s a pink hibiscus  %s %s cheese nibbles

gui.guhs.guhwaii.hint.capsule_gevonden: A capsule! With a weird meter inside... and it's empty. Tell Lilo-guh!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.hint.opruimen: Help Nani-guh tidy up: click the bits of mess in and around the stilt house.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.hint.ohana: 626-guh has become sweet! Go back to Lilo-guh.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.hint.temmen: Give 626-guh (by the shelter) a cheese nibble: then he'll come home with you. Only once, so take good care of him!

gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.tikiguh: Rarity: Unique (one on every Guhwai'i Surf Beach)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.tikiguh: Nobody knows what Tiki Guh looks like without his mask. He always holds it in front of his snoot, on a bamboo stick, with palm leaves on top. "A tiki is something you feel, not something you see," he says. He sells the finest tiki goodies for Seashell Coins: torches, masks, little lanterns and even a little radio with hula music. Under his grass skirt there's just a chonky guh tummy. Nyeg!
structure.guhs.guhwaii_surfstrand.toolti: Minigames: surfing and hula with Lilo-guh, seashell coins and Tiki Guh's Tiki stand (Guhwai'i)
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.niet_bouwen: Nyeg! The surf beach belongs to Lilo-guh and Tiki Guh: no breaking or building here.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.welkom: Aloha! I'm Lilo-guh. Have you ever surfed? No? Then I'll teach you! I'll lend you my board, and I'll surf right next to you. Ohana surfs together!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.hallo1: Aloha, nyeg! The waves are WAHOOG today. Fancy a ride?
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.hallo2: Look, here comes a set of waves! Grab your board, quick!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.hallo3: Know what the secret is? Stay ahead of the foam. The foam is sweet, but it knocks you off your board.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.hallo4: I did three nibble spins this morning! Well, two. One was more of a splash.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.bezig: You're surfing! Hold sneak for a moment if you want to paddle back to the beach.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.geen_golv: Nyeg... I don't see any open water here. Where did the waves go?
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.uitleg: Surfing! Face the beach. A/D: along the beach. Wave coming? Paddle with W! On the wave: W down the wave (speed!), S up to the crest, space: jump at the crest. In the air: A/D spin, S grab your board. Stay ahead of the foam! To stop: hold sneak.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.plons1: Oopsie, SPLASH! No worries, climb back on. Ohana leaves no one behind!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.plons2: Nyeg, wet! That's part of it. Next wave!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.plons3: Hee hee, you looked like a cheese nibble in soup. One more time!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.plons4: Splashie! Even the best surf guhs take a dunk now and then.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.eerste: Your very first time surfing! Here: Seashell Coins and a surfboard rack for home. Aloha, wahoog!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.uitslag: ≈ Surfing done: %s points (%s), +%s Seashell Coins. Waves ridden: %s, tricks: %s ≈
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.record_eerste: Your first score: %s points. Instantly your record, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.titel.sub: %s - look at the beach, the waves are coming
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.sneak: Keep sneaking to paddle back to the beach...
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.mis: Missed! Wait for the next wave...
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.schuim: Oopsie, the foam is rolling over you!
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.tube_in: IN THE TUBE! Stay in there!
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.golf_strand: All the way to the beach, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.klaar: The waves are all gone. Aloha!
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.hint.wacht: Wait for a wave... (A/D along the beach)
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.hint.rijden: W: down the wave (speed)  S: up to the crest  space: jump
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.hint.tube: In the tube! Stay just ahead of the foam, high on the wave!
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.hint.lucht: Spin with A/D, grab with S! (%s°)
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.hint.plons: Pfff... sputter... coming up for air...
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.truc.dubbel_grab: Double Nibble Spin with a nyeg-grab!!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.welkom: Aloha! Want to dance? In hula you talk with your hips. I show you, you copy me, right on the beat of the music. Nyeg-nyeg!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.hallo1: Aloha, nyeg! The ukulele is tuned, the flowers are ready. Shall we dance?
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.hallo2: Hips left, hips right, and then... WAHOOG! It's that simple!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.hallo3: My sister Nani-guh says I dance too much. But a guh can never dance too much!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.hallo4: A guh with a big quiff once sang this song on the beach. Everyone fainted. From happiness!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.bezig: You're dancing! Watch the steps sliding in, and press right on the beat.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.druk: %s is dancing with me right now. Watch along, and dance yourself in a bit!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.geen_mat: Nyeg... where's my flower mat? Without a mat I can't dance.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.uitleg.ma: Hula! The steps slide from the right to the flower. Press when they're on it: A hips left, D hips right. Slow and sweet, right on the beat!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.uitleg.me: Hula! Press when a step is on the flower: A hips left, D hips right, W arms up, S bend your knees. To the beat of the rock'n'roll!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.uitleg.la: Hula, fast! A left, D right, W arms up, S bend your knees, and at a golden star: space, WAHOOG! Half beats are coming too.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.weg: You stepped off the stage. The music stops... nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.uitslag: ✿ Hula done: %s points (%s), +%s Seashell Coins. WAHOOG! %s, Nyeg! %s, Guh. %s, miss %s, longest streak %s ✿
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.foutloos: NOT A SINGLE STEP MISSED! You're a real hula guh! It brings tears to my eyes. Happy tears!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.klaar1: Beautifully danced! Your hips were totally wahoog.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.klaar2: Aloha! Another song? Practice loosens up the hips.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.klaar3: Hee hee, you dance just like my sister: with your tongue sticking out. Very impressive!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.eerste: Your first hula! Here: Seashell Coins and two flower mats, to keep practicing at home. Aloha!
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.klaar_makke: Ready? A and D, on the beat... shake those hips!
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.klaar_mediu: Ready? A, D, W and S, to the beat of the rock'n'roll!
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.klaar_lasti: Ready? Quick now, and space at the golden stars: WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.vraag: Surfing? I'll lend you my board and we'll paddle out to the waves together. Catch them, ride them out, do tricks off the crest and stay ahead of the foam. The more points, the more Seashell Coins!
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.vraag: Hula dancing? Pick a song. I'll show you the steps, you press them right on the beat. The prettier you dance, the more Seashell Coins!
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.mine: You're surfing! Want to go back to the beach?
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.druk: %s is dancing the hula right now. Watch along, your turn is next!
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.stop.toolti: Your surf session stops; your points still count
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.stop.toolti: The song stops; what you've danced so far counts
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.niveau.makk: Small, slow little waves. You catch them automatically. No tube.
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.niveau.medi: Nice waves. Paddle into them with W. Next to the foam, a tube curls!
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.niveau.last: Big, fast waves that break quickly. Land just right!
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.niveau.makk: A slow moonlight song (%s BPM). Just your hips: A and D.
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.niveau.medi: Rock'n'roll on the beach (%s BPM). A, D, W and S.
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.niveau.last: Surf rock! (%s BPM) Half beats, and space at the WAHOOG! stars.
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.toetsen: Look at the beach. A/D: along the beach. W: paddle / down the wave. S: up to the crest. Space: jump. In the air: A/D to spin, S to grab.
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.toetsen: A hips left, D hips right, W arms up, S bend your knees, space WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.munten_nu: You have %s Seashell Coins. Tiki Guh trades them for tiki goodies!
gui.guhs.guhwaiispellen.eerste: Your first time? Then you get a little present too!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.tiki.blut: Aloha! No Seashell Coins? Go surfing or dancing with Lilo-guh, and you'll come back rich. Looking is always allowed!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.tiki.hallo1: Aloha, nyeg! %s Seashell Coins? You can get lovely things for those!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.tiki.hallo2: Welcome to my little stall! Everything carved by hand. Well, by paw. (%s seashells in your pocket)
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.tiki.hallo3: No, I'm not taking my mask off. A tiki is meant to be felt, not seen. (%s seashells)
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.tiki.hallo4: The little radio is my favorite. It plays the hula songs, at home too! (%s seashells)
advancements.guhs.verhalen.guhwaii_spell: Aloha, Surf Beach!
Find Guhwai'i Surf Beach: surfing and hula with Lilo-guh, and Tiki Guh's Tiki stand
Caught a Wave, Nyeg!
Surf a wave all the way out with Lilo-guh
Nibble Spin!
Jump off the crest of a wave and spin a full circle in the air before you land
Through the Tube, WAHOOG!
Surf for a while in the curl of a breaking wave, just ahead of the foam (medium or hard)
King of the Waves
Surf 6000 points or more on hard
Shake Those Hips!
Dance a hula song with Lilo-guh on the stage
Not One Step Missed
Dance a whole song on medium or hard without missing a single step
Easy, Medium, Hard!
Surf and dance on all three levels (six rows in your Guhdex)
Tiki-Tiki-Nyeg
Buy something pretty at Tiki Guh's Tiki stand
Hula at Home
Buy the little Tiki radio: the hula songs of Guhwai'i, at home too
advancements.guhs.diertjes.vogels_pluisv: Put a Fluff Finch in your Guhdex
advancements.guhs.diertjes.vogels_kaasme: Put a Cheese Chickadee in your Guhdex
advancements.guhs.diertjes.vogels_guh_ui: Put a Guh Owlet in your Guhdex
advancements.guhs.diertjes.vogels_zeemee: Put a Seagull in your Guhdex
advancements.guhs.diertjes.vogels_pluisv: Find a fluff feather from a Fluff Finch
advancements.guhs.diertjes.vogels_voeren: Give a little bird its favorite snack
advancements.guhs.diertjes.vogels_voerhu: Put seeds in a bird feeder
advancements.guhs.diertjes.vogels_sluipe: Sneak right up to a little bird without it flying away
advancements.guhs.diertjes.vogels_onders: See a Cheese Chickadee hanging upside down under the leaves
Hear a Guh Owlet call in the night
advancements.guhs.diertjes.vogels_mijn.d: Make a Seagull shout "Mine!" at your fishie
advancements.guhs.diertjes.vogels_alle.d: Put all four little birds of the Guhmension in your Guhdex
item.guhs.pluisveertje.lore: As soft as a little cloud. From a Fluff Finch!
item.guhs.pluisveertje.lore2: The Cloud Shepherd of the Cloud Chapel is looking for one. Right-click: pfff!
block.guhs.vogels_voerhuisje.lore: Put seeds on it and the birdies come for a feast. Fluff Finches sometimes leave a feather behind!
item.guhs.vogels_voerhuisje.lore: Put seeds on it and the birdies come for a feast. Fluff Finches sometimes leave a feather behind!
gui.guhs.vogels.voerhuisje.gevuld: Seeds in the bird feeder: %s of %s. Dig in, birdies!
gui.guhs.vogels.voerhuisje.vol: The bird feeder is already totally full. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.pluisvinkje: Rarity: Common, in flocks, in the Guh Fields, the Pink Puffs and the Guh Meadows
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.pluisvinkje: A round pink-and-white ball of fluff with guh ears! Fluff Finches fly in little flocks behind their leader and love sitting in guh blossom trees. Sometimes a soft fluff feather drifts down, especially when you give them seeds. Sneak up closer, or the whole flock flutters away. Tweet-nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kaasmeesje: Rarity: In the Chonkwood Forest and the Cheese Flats
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kaasmeesje: A yellow chickadee with a cheese stripe (with holes!) on its belly and a lilac guh cap. Loves hanging upside down under the leaves and pecking at ripe nibbleberries (it leaves them hanging for you, sweet, huh?). Give it berries and it sings: chick-a-dee-cheese!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.guh_uiltje: Rarity: Rare, in the Guh Peaks and the Chonkwood Forest (awake at night)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.guh_uiltje: By day the Guh Owlet sleeps all puffed up on a branch. At night its little eyes open and glow in the dark. Its ears are real guh ears, and its little head turns all the way around to keep an eye on you. Hoo-hoo... nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.zeemeeuwtje: Rarity: Along the Guh Sea, the Deep Guh Sea and on Guhwai'i
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.zeemeeuwtje: Mine! Mine! A cheeky but sweet little seagull. Hold up a fish (or bread) and the whole beach comes circling over your head. A fish on the ground? Gone! But they leave your other stuff alone. Loves bobbing on the waves.
advancements.guhs.diertjes.waterdiertjes: Blub-Nyeg!
Put a guhxolotl in your Guhdex: a guh that's an axolotl, with fluffy little gills
Worth Its Weight in Gold
See a rare golden guhxolotl up close
My Very Own Blubby
Tame a guhxolotl with a little guhfish
A Bucketful of Love
Scoop a guhxolotl into a bucket
All the Blub Colors
Tame a pink, a mint, a choco, a white AND a golden guhxolotl
Quack-Nyeg!
Put a Guh Duckling in your Guhdex
All in a Row
See a mama duck with at least three ducklings trailing behind her
Flitter-Flutter
Put a Nibble Butterfly in your Guhdex
Little Lights in the Night
Put a Glowguh in your Guhdex (they only come out at night)
Spots with Ears
Put a Ladybug in your Guhdex
Sweet Little Helpers
See a Ladybug make your guh garden grow a tiny bit faster
Blub, Quack, Flutter, Glow!
Put all five water and bug critters in your Guhdex
item.guhs.guhxolotl_emmertje.tooltip: Right-click a block: splash, there it swims again! (Sneak: without water)
gui.guhs.piep.opgepakt.guhxolotl: %s is safe and sound in a little bucket. Blub!
gui.guhs.piep.neergezet.guhxolotl: Splash! %s is happily swimming around again.
gui.guhs.piep.menu.speciaal.guhxolotl.to: Your guhxolotl blows a cloud of bubblies around you: for two whole minutes you can breathe underwater, nyeg!
gui.guhs.piep.menu.sub.guhxolotl: A guh who is an axolotl. Blub-nyeg!
gui.guhs.waterdiertjes.getemd: %s blubs happily: you're buddies now! Blub-nyeg!
gui.guhs.waterdiertjes.droog: %s is getting a bit dry and would love to go back in the water...
gui.guhs.waterdiertjes.blubbeltjes: %s blows a cloud of bubblies around you: you can breathe underwater for a while!
gui.guhs.waterdiertjes.alle_kleurtjes: All the blub colors! Pink, mint, choco, white AND GOLD. What a WAHOOG collection, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.guhxolotl: Rarity: Common (shallow water of the Guh Sea and the Cheese Swamp). Gold: very rare!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.guhxolotl: A guh who is an axolotl: a round guh head, guh eyes, a little snoot, blushies and pink fluffy gills. They come in pink, mint, choco, white and (very rarely) GOLD. Tame it with a little guhfish and scoop it into a bucket. Plays dead if you hurt it (shame on you!).
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.guh_eendje: Rarity: Common (ponds, the Guh Sea and the Cheese Swamp)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.guh_eendje: A mama duck with guh ears and a little row of fluffy yellow ducklings behind her. Every duckling follows the duckling in front. Quack-nyeg! Likes seeds, bread and cheese nibbles.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.knabbelvlindertje: A little butterfly with a teeny-tiny guh head and wings full of nibble spots. In cheese yellow, pink, mint and lilac. Flutters from flower to flower and sleeps on a little flower at night.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.glimguhtje: Rarity: Only at night (Cheese Swamp and Guh Meadows)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.glimguhtje: A teeny-tiny round guh with a little light in its tummy. At night they float in dreamy circles above the grass and the water. At sunrise they softly glow away.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.lieveheersbeestje: Rarity: Common (near flowers and Guh Gardens)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.lieveheersbeestje: A ladybug with spots shaped like guh heads. It loves landing on your Guh Gardens and makes them grow a tiny bit faster. Sweet little helper!
item.guhs.landdiertjes_guhsteentje.lore: Polished smooth and shiny by a Shuckly. Four of them make a guh pebble path.
item.guhs.landdiertjes_bessensapje.lore: Sweet berries, made into juice veeery patiently inside a Shuckly's shell. Slurp! Nyeg.
item.guhs.pluisegeltje_item.tooltip: A picked-up fluffhog (name and all). Right-click a block: it snuffles off again.
item.guhs.guh_konijntje_item.tooltip: A picked-up guh bunny (name and all). Right-click a block: hop, off it goes!
item.guhs.pluiseekhoorntje_item.tooltip: Right-click a block: the squirrel jumps off. Right-click in the air: onto your shoulder!
item.guhs.shuckle_item.tooltip: A picked-up Shuckly (name and all). Sitting snug in its shell. Right-click a block: off it goes, veeery slowly.
gui.guhs.piep.menu.sub.pluisegeltje: Fluffhog: soft little spines, lots and lots of cuddles
gui.guhs.piep.menu.sub.guh_konijntje: Guh Bunny: floppy ears and hop-hop
gui.guhs.piep.menu.sub.pluiseekhoorntje: Fluff Squirrel: hides nibbles and sits on your shoulder
gui.guhs.piep.menu.sub.shuckle: Shuckly: not a guh, but very sweet (and very slow)
gui.guhs.piep.menu.speciaal.pluisegeltje: Your fluffhog curls up into a fluffy little ball and rolls a lap around you. Wheee!
gui.guhs.piep.menu.speciaal.guh_konijntj: A happy binky! And you get bunny hops for a while (jump higher).
gui.guhs.piep.menu.speciaal.pluiseekhoor: The squirrel climbs onto your shoulder. Sneak + right-click a block (empty hand): hop off.
gui.guhs.piep.menu.speciaal.shuckle.tool: With 3 sweet berries in his tummy, Shuckly crawls into his shell and turns them into berry juice.
gui.guhs.piep.opgepakt.pluisegeltje: You pick up %s. Very carefully... but it doesn't prickle at all. Fluff!
gui.guhs.piep.opgepakt.guh_konijntje: You pick up %s. His floppy ears flap happily. Hop!
gui.guhs.piep.opgepakt.pluiseekhoorntje: You pick up %s. His tail tickles your nose!
gui.guhs.piep.opgepakt.shuckle: You pick up %s. He pulls his head in: tink!
gui.guhs.piep.neergezet.pluisegeltje: %s is sniffing around again. Sniff sniff!
gui.guhs.piep.neergezet.pluiseekhoorntje: %s jumps off and right away checks for nibbles lying around.
gui.guhs.piep.neergezet.shuckle: %s very carefully pokes his head back out. Hello!
gui.guhs.landdiertjes.getemd.pluisegeltj: %s uncurls and sniffs your hand. You're buddies now! Fluff!
gui.guhs.landdiertjes.getemd.guh_konijnt: %s does a happy binky. You're buddies now! Hop-hop!
gui.guhs.landdiertjes.getemd.pluiseekhoo: %s stuffs the nibble into his cheeks and gives you the sweetest look. Buddies!
gui.guhs.landdiertjes.getemd.shuckle: %s comes all the way out of his shell and blinks his beady little eyes. Buddies! (very slowly)
gui.guhs.landdiertjes.egeltje_opgerold: The fluffhog is all curled up... Stay very still for a bit (or sneak), and it'll come back out.
gui.guhs.landdiertjes.egeltje_rondje: %s rolls a lap around you. Wheee! Fluff!
gui.guhs.landdiertjes.hophop: %s does a happy binky! You get bunny hops. Hop-hop!
gui.guhs.landdiertjes.op_schouder: %s climbs onto your shoulder. (Sneak + right-click a block: hop off.)
gui.guhs.landdiertjes.schouder_vol: Someone is already sitting on your shoulder, nyeg.
gui.guhs.landdiertjes.voorraadje_gevonde: A little nibble stash! You dig up %s cheese nibbles. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.landdiertjes.voorraadje_cadeau: %s dug up a little stash for you! Take a look in that pile of dirt.
gui.guhs.landdiertjes.shuckle_in_schelp: Shuckly is in his shell... Sneak closer and wait a moment, then he'll come out.
gui.guhs.landdiertjes.shuckle_bessen: %s keeps the berries in his shell (%s). Soon it'll be juice!
gui.guhs.landdiertjes.shuckle_sapje: %s crawls into his shell and... blub blub... it's turning into berry juice!
gui.guhs.landdiertjes.shuckle_geen_besse: %s needs %s sweet berries first to make juice. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.klus.polijsten.tip: Shuckly only: cobblestones in the chest become smooth stone and shiny guh pebbles
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_polijste: I polished stones. Very slowly. Very smooth. Very pretty.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.polijsten: Did you know the stones at %s are shiny now? I polished them with my pawsies. Tink tink.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.pluisegeltje: Rarity: Common in the Chonkwood Forest
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.pluisegeltje: A little hedgehog with soft, fluffy spines: they never prick, they're really cuddle spines. When it gets a fright it rolls up into a fluffy ball (sneak, and it stays calm). It adores sweet berries and walks right through berry bushes without an ouch. Tame it with sweet berries!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.guh_konijntje: Rarity: Common in the Guh Meadows (and white in the Snowguh Tundra)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.guh_konijntje: A round little bunny with long floppy ears, a wiggly nose and a pompom tail. They come in pink, white, choco and gray. It hops around everywhere and runs off if you come stomping up too loudly. Tame it with a carrot or a cheese nibble. Once tamed it does a happy binky: hop hop!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.pluiseekhoorntje: Rarity: In guh blossom trees and the Chonkwood Forest
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.pluiseekhoorntje: A fluffy little squirrel with a huge curly tail and tufts on its ears. It hides little stashes of cheese nibbles in the ground all over the place (look for the little dirt mounds!). Tame it with cheese nibbles: then it sits on your shoulder and now and then digs up a stash for you.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.shuckle: Rarity: Rare: around Clone Island, and very occasionally deep in the Holey Cheese Caves
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.shuckle: Not a guh! A red shell full of cheese holes, a yellow head with beady eyes and yellow feet poking out of the holes. Very, very slow, and very shy: get too close and it crawls into its shell. Sneak up and give it sweet berries. Once tamed it turns berries into a yummy berry juice, and in a Guh House it polishes stones.

What a Tail!

A Secret Stash
